पञ्चमस्य युजित्वे तौ परित्यक्तनिजात्मकौ ॥ 211
15.m: The division of directions born of that comes from their four faces; / if they were joined with a fifth, they would abandon their proper nature. // 211

15.s:
tato brahmāṇḍamadhye'pi jñānaśaktirvibho raviḥ /
diśāṃ vibhāgaṃ kurute prakāśaghanavṛttimān // 212
15.d:
ततो ब्रह्माण्डमध्येऽपि ज्ञानशक्तिर्विभो रविः ।
दिशां विभागं कुरुते प्रकाशघनवृत्तिमान् ॥ 212
15.m: Then, even in the midst of the cosmic egg, the sun—the pervasive power of knowledge / possessing an activity dense with luminosity—effects the division of the directions. // 212

15.s:
tathāhi viṣuvadyoge yataḥ pūrvaṃ pradṛśyate /
tatpūrva yatra tacchāyā tatpaścimamudāhṛtam // 213
15.d:
तथाहि विषुवद्योगे यतः पूर्वं प्रदृश्यते ।
तत्पूर्व यत्र तच्छाया तत्पश्चिममुदाहृतम् ॥ 213
15.m: For instance, at the equinoctial conjunction, that [point] from which it is first seen / is the east; where its shadow falls is proclaimed to be the west; // 213

15.s:
tasmiñjigamiṣorasya yatsavyaṃ tattu dakṣiṇam /
tatraiṣa caṇḍatejobhirbhāti jājvalyamānavat // 214
15.d:
तस्मिञ्जिगमिषोरस्य यत्सव्यं तत्तु दक्षिणम् ।
तत्रैष चण्डतेजोभिर्भाति जाज्वल्यमानवत् ॥ 214
15.m: as it desires to proceed toward that [west], what is to its left is the south; / there it shines as if blazing with fierce radiance; // 214

15.s:
tatpurovarti vāmaṃ tu tadbhāsā khacitaṃ manāk /
tata eva hi somyaṃ tannacāpi hyaprakāśakam // 215
15.d:
तत्पुरोवर्ति वामं तु तद्भासा खचितं मनाक् ।
तत एव हि सोम्यं तन्नचापि ह्यप्रकाशकम् ॥ 215
15.m: what is in front of that, however, is the north, subtly overlaid by its light; / for that very reason it is gentle, yet by no means unilluminated. // 215

15.s:
yatrāsāvastamabhyeti tatpaścimamiti sthitiḥ /
tatraiva paścime yeṣāṃ prākprakāśāvalokanam // 216
15.d:
यत्रासावस्तमभ्येति तत्पश्चिममिति स्थितिः ।
तत्रैव पश्चिमे येषां प्राक्प्रकाशावलोकनम् ॥ 216
15.m: Where that [sun] sets is the west; this is the established rule. / For those whose perception of luminosity earlier arose precisely there in the west,

15.s:
tadeva pūrvameteṣāṃ yathādhvani nirūpitam /
sā sā dikca tathā tasya phaladāpi viparyaye // 217
15.d:
तदेव पूर्वमेतेषां यथाध्वनि निरूपितम् ।
सा सा दिक्च तथा तस्य फलदापि विपर्यये ॥ 217
15.m: that indeed is the east for them, as explained on the path. / And that respective direction yields fruit for him in that manner, or also inversely [if reversed],

15.s:
vicitre phalasaṃpattiḥ prakāśādhīnikā yataḥ /
itthaṃ sūryāśrayā diksyātsā vicitrāpi tādṛśī // 218
15.d:
विचित्रे फलसंपत्तिः प्रकाशाधीनिका यतः ।
इत्थं सूर्याश्रया दिक्स्यात्सा विचित्रापि तादृशी ॥ 218
15.m: since the attainment of fruit in variety depends upon luminosity. / Thus the direction based on the sun may be manifold, yet of such a nature,

15.s:
adhiṣṭhitā maheśena citratadrūpadhāriṇā /
kiṃ vātibahunā yo'sau yaṣṭā tatsaṃmukhāditaḥ // 219
15.d:
अधिष्ठिता महेशेन चित्रतद्रूपधारिणा ।
किं वातिबहुना योऽसौ यष्टा तत्संमुखादितः ॥ 219
15.m: presided over by the Great Lord who assumes that manifold form. / Or what is the use of prolixity? Beginning from facing him who is the sacrificer,

15.s:
diśo'pi pravibhajyante prāksavyottarapaścimāḥ /
svānusārakṛtaṃ taṃ ca digvibhāgaṃ sadā śivaḥ // 220
15.d:
दिशोऽपि प्रविभज्यन्ते प्राक्सव्योत्तरपश्चिमाः ।
स्वानुसारकृतं तं च दिग्विभागं सदा शिवः ॥ 220
15.m: directions are also differentiated as east, south, north, and west. / And that division of directions made according to oneself, Sadāśiva

15.s:
adhitiṣṭhatyarkamiva sa vicitravapuryataḥ /
svotthā api diśaḥ sveśāḥ śakrādyā hyadhiśerate // 221
15.d:
अधितिष्ठत्यर्कमिव स विचित्रवपुर्यतः ।
स्वोत्था अपि दिशः स्वेशाः शक्राद्या ह्यधिशेरते ॥ 221
15.m: presides over, just like the sun, because his form is manifold. / For Indra and the other [guardians], lords of their own [quarters], rule over the directions arisen from oneself.

15.s:
te hi prakāśaśaktyaṃśāḥ prakāśānuvidhāyinaḥ /
prakāśasya yadaiśvaryaṃ sa indro yattu tanmahaḥ // 222
15.d:
ते हि प्रकाशशक्त्यंशाः प्रकाशानुविधायिनः ।
प्रकाशस्य यदैश्वर्यं स इन्द्रो यत्तु तन्महः ॥ 222
15.m: For they are portions of the power of luminosity, conforming to luminosity: / the sovereignty belonging to luminosity is Indra; that splendour of it

15.s:
so'gniryantṛtvabhīmatve yamo rakṣastadūnimā /
prakāśyaṃ varuṇastacca cāñcalyādvāyurucyate // 223
15.d:
सोऽग्निर्यन्तृत्वभीमत्वे यमो रक्षस्तदूनिमा ।
प्रकाश्यं वरुणस्तच्च चाञ्चल्याद्वायुरुच्यते ॥ 223
15.m: is Agni; [its] restraint and dreadfulness are Yama; the Rakṣas is its deficiency; / that which is illuminated is Varuṇa, and from [its] mobility it is called Vāyu;

15.s:
bhāvasañcayayogena vitteśastatkṣaye vibhuḥ /
adṛṣṭavigraho'nanto brahmordhve vṛṃhako vibhuḥ // 224
15.d:
भावसञ्चययोगेन वित्तेशस्तत्क्षये विभुः ।
अदृष्टविग्रहोऽनन्तो ब्रह्मोर्ध्वे वृंहको विभुः ॥ 224
15.m: by connection with the accumulation of entities, it is [Kubera] the lord of wealth; upon their destruction, it is the all-pervading [Īśāna]; / Ananta has an unmanifest form; and Brahmā above is the all-pervading expander.

15.s:
prakāśasyaiva śaktyaṃśā lokapāstena kīrtitāḥ /
itthaṃ svādhīnarūpāpi diksaurī tūpadiśyate // 225
15.d:
प्रकाशस्यैव शक्त्यंशा लोकपास्तेन कीर्तिताः ।
इत्थं स्वाधीनरूपापि दिक्सौरी तूपदिश्यते ॥ 225
15.m: The world-guardians are celebrated as precisely portions of the power of luminosity. / In this way, although its nature is self-dependent, the solar direction is taught,

15.s:
tatra sarvo hi niṣkampaṃ prakāśatvaṃ prapadyate /
sarvago'pyanilo yadvadvyajanenopavījitaḥ // 226
15.d:
तत्र सर्वो हि निष्कम्पं प्रकाशत्वं प्रपद्यते ।
सर्वगोऽप्यनिलो यद्वद्व्यजनेनोपवीजितः ॥ 226
15.m: for in that regard everyone attains the unshakeable state of luminosity. / Just as the wind, though omnipresent, when fanned by a fan

15.s:
prabuddhaḥ svāṃ kriyāṃ kuryāddharmanirṇodanādikām /
tadvatsarvagatāḥ sarvā aindyādyāḥ śaktayaḥ sphuṭam // 227
15.d:
प्रबुद्धः स्वां क्रियां कुर्याद्धर्मनिर्णोदनादिकाम् ।
तद्वत्सर्वगताः सर्वा ऐन्द्याद्याः शक्तयः स्फुटम् ॥ 227
15.m: becomes active and performs its function, such as dispelling heat, / so all the powers—those of Indra and the rest—are clearly omnipresent,

15.s:
sādhakāśvāsasaṃbuddhāstattatsveṣṭaphalapradāḥ /
evaṃ saurī digīśānabrahmaviṣṇvīśasauśivaiḥ // 228
15.d:
साधकाश्वाससंबुद्धास्तत्तत्स्वेष्टफलप्रदाः ।
एवं सौरी दिगीशानब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशसौशिवैः ॥ 228
15.m: awakened by the confidence of the adept, granting their respective desired fruits. / Thus the solar direction, presided over by Īśāna, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Īśa, and Śiva,

15.s:
adhiṣṭhitā samāśvāsadārḍhyāttattatphalapradā /
sādhako yacca vā kṣetraṃ maṇḍalaṃ veśma vā bhajet // 229
15.d:
अधिष्ठिता समाश्वासदार्ढ्यात्तत्तत्फलप्रदा ।
साधको यच्च वा क्षेत्रं मण्डलं वेश्म वा भजेत् ॥ 229
15.m: grants the respective fruits through firmness of confidence. / Or whichever sacred field, mandala, or chamber the adept resorts to,

15.s:
sthitastadanusāreṇa madhyībhavati śaṃkaraḥ /
sa hi sarvamadhiṣṭhātā mādhyasthyeneti tasya yaḥ // 230
15.d:
स्थितस्तदनुसारेण मध्यीभवति शंकरः ।
स हि सर्वमधिष्ठाता माध्यस्थ्येनेति तस्य यः ॥ 230
15.m: Śaṃkara, abiding in conformity with that, becomes central; / for he presides over all through centrality. Hence, whatever

15.s:
sauraḥ prakāśastatpūrvamitthaṃ syāddigvyavasthitiḥ /
tanmadhyasthitanāthasya grahītuṃ dakṣiṇaṃ mahaḥ // 231
15.d:
सौरः प्रकाशस्तत्पूर्वमित्थं स्याद्दिग्व्यवस्थितिः ।
तन्मध्यस्थितनाथस्य ग्रहीतुं दक्षिणं महः ॥ 231
15.m: is his solar luminosity, that is the east; in this way the arrangement of directions is established. / To grasp the southern splendour of that Lord situated in the centre,

15.s:
udaṅmukhaḥ syāt pāścātyaṃ grahītuṃ pūrvatomukhaḥ /
upaviśya nijasthāne dehaśuddhiṃ samācaret // 232
15.d:
उदङ्मुखः स्यात् पाश्चात्यं ग्रहीतुं पूर्वतोमुखः ।
उपविश्य निजस्थाने देहशुद्धिं समाचरेत् ॥ 232
15.m: one should face north; to grasp the western, one should face east. / Having sat down in one's place, one should perform the purification of the body.

15.s:
aṅguṣṭhāgrātkālavahnijvālābhāsvaramutthitam /
astraṃ dhyātvā tacchikhābhirbahirantardahettanum // 233
15.d:
अङ्गुष्ठाग्रात्कालवह्निज्वालाभास्वरमुत्थितम् ।
अस्त्रं ध्यात्वा तच्छिखाभिर्बहिरन्तर्दहेत्तनुम् ॥ 233
15.m: Having meditated upon the Astra arisen from the tip of the big toe, blazing with the flames of the fire of time, / one should burn the body, outside and inside, with its flames.

15.s:
dāhaśca dhvaṃsa evokto dhvaṃsakaṃ mantrasaṃjñitam /
tejastathābhilāpākhyasvavikalparasombhitam // 234
15.d:
दाहश्च ध्वंस एवोक्तो ध्वंसकं मन्त्रसंज्ञितम् ।
तेजस्तथाभिलापाख्यस्वविकल्परसोम्भितम् ॥ 234
15.m: And burning is declared to be destruction; the destroyer is the splendour called mantra, / filled with the flavour of one's own conceptual construct designated as articulation.

15.s:
tena mantrāgninā dāho dehe puryaṣṭake tathā /
dehapuryaṣṭakāhantāvidhvaṃsādeva jāyate // 235
15.d:
तेन मन्त्राग्निना दाहो देहे पुर्यष्टके तथा ।
देहपुर्यष्टकाहन्ताविध्वंसादेव जायते ॥ 235
15.m: Burning by that fire of mantra occurs in the [physical] body and also in the subtle body, / precisely through the destruction of the ego-sense in the body and the subtle body.

15.s:
nahi sadbhāvamātreṇa deho'sāvanyadehavat /
ahantāyāṃ hi dehatvaṃ sā dhvastā taddaheddhruvam // 236
15.d:
नहि सद्भावमात्रेण देहोऽसावन्यदेहवत् ।
अहन्तायां हि देहत्वं सा ध्वस्ता तद्दहेद्ध्रुवम् ॥ 236
15.m: For this body is not [burned] merely by its existence, like another's body; / for bodyhood consists in the ego-sense; when that is destroyed, it certainly burns it.

15.s:
taddehasaṃskārabharo bhasmatvenātha yaḥ sthitaḥ /
taṃ varmavāyunādhūya tiṣṭhecchuddhacidātmani // 237
15.d:
तद्देहसंस्कारभरो भस्मत्वेनाथ यः स्थितः ।
तं वर्मवायुनाधूय तिष्ठेच्छुद्धचिदात्मनि ॥ 237
15.m: Then, having dispersed with the wind of the Varma [mantra] the mass of traces of that body which remains as ashes, / one should abide in the pure Self of consciousness.

15.s:
tasmindhruve nistaraṅge samāpattimupāgataḥ /
saṃvidaḥ sṛṣṭidharmitvādādyāmeti taraṅgitām // 238
15.d:
तस्मिन्ध्रुवे निस्तरङ्गे समापत्तिमुपागतः ।
संविदः सृष्टिधर्मित्वादाद्यामेति तरङ्गिताम् ॥ 238
15.m: Having attained absorption in that firm, waveless [state], / because consciousness has the character of creation, one attains the primal, waving [expansion].

15.s:
saiva mūrtiriti khyātā tārasadbinduhātmikā /
tato navātmadevena nyāsastattvodayātmakaḥ // 239
15.d:
सैव मूर्तिरिति ख्याता तारसद्बिन्दुहात्मिका ।
ततो नवात्मदेवेन न्यासस्तत्त्वोदयात्मकः ॥ 239
15.m: That very [expansion] is known as the Mūrti, consisting of the Omkāra, the true bindu, and the letter H; / then [comes] the imposition by the deity Navātman, consisting of the emergence of principles.

15.s:
aṅgavaktrāṇi tasyaiva svasthāneṣu niyojayet /
atha mātṛkayā prāgvattattattvasphuṭatātmakaḥ // 240
15.d:
अङ्गवक्त्राणि तस्यैव स्वस्थानेषु नियोजयेत् ।
अथ मातृकया प्राग्वत्तत्तत्त्वस्फुटतात्मकः ॥ 240
15.m: One should assign the limbs and faces of that very deity in their proper places. / Then, with the Mātṛkā, as before, consisting of the clarity of those principles,

15.s:
tritattvanyāsatā cāsya pṛṣṭhe kakṣyātrayāgate /
tato'ghorāṣṭakanyāsaḥ śirastaccaraṇātmakam // 241
15.d:
त्रितत्त्वन्यासता चास्य पृष्ठे कक्ष्यात्रयागते ।
ततोऽघोराष्टकन्यासः शिरस्तच्चरणात्मकम् ॥ 241
15.m: the imposition of the three principles follows upon the attainment of the three stages; / then the imposition of the eight Aghoras, consisting of the head and its feet;

15.s:
tato'pi śivasadbhāvanyāsaḥ svāṃgasya saṃyutaḥ /
ittha kṛte pañcake'sminyattanmukhyatayā bhavet // 242
15.d:
ततोऽपि शिवसद्भावन्यासः स्वांगस्य संयुतः ।
इत्थ कृते पञ्चकेऽस्मिन्यत्तन्मुख्यतया भवेत् ॥ 242
15.m: then also the imposition of the reality of Śiva accompanied by its own limbs. / When this pentad has been performed in this manner, whatever is primary

15.s:
upāsyamarcyaṃ tatsāṅgaṃ ṣaṣṭhe nyāse niyojayet /
tenātra nyāsayogyo'sau bhagavānratiśekharaḥ // 243
15.d:
उपास्यमर्च्यं तत्साङ्गं षष्ठे न्यासे नियोजयेत् ।
तेनात्र न्यासयोग्योऽसौ भगवान्रतिशेखरः ॥ 243
15.m: as that which is to be worshiped and adored along with its limbs, one should employ in the sixth imposition. / Therefore, the venerable Ratiśekhara is fit for imposition here;

15.s:
ūrdhve nyāsyo navākhyasya mukhyatve'nyonyadhāmatā /
evaṃ bhairavasadbhāvanāthe mukhyatayā yadi // 244
15.d:
ऊर्ध्वे न्यास्यो नवाख्यस्य मुख्यत्वेऽन्योन्यधामता ।
एवं भैरवसद्भावनाथे मुख्यतया यदि ॥ 244
15.m: he is to be imposed above; when Navātman is primary, they have mutual abodes. / Thus, if the Lord Bhairavasadbhāva is primary

15.s:
upāsyatā tattatsthāna prāṅnyāsyo ratiśekharaḥ /
itthaṃ śrīpūrvaśāstre me saṃpradāyaṃ nyarūpayat // 245
15.d:
उपास्यता तत्तत्स्थान प्राङ्न्यास्यो रतिशेखरः ।
इत्थं श्रीपूर्वशास्त्रे मे संप्रदायं न्यरूपयत् ॥ 245
15.m: as the object of worship, Ratiśekhara is to be imposed before [him] in his respective place. / In this way, with regard to the ritual of imposition, Śambhunātha explained

15.s:
śaṃbhunātho nyāsavidhau devo hi kathamanyathā /
nyāsa vivarjyate'muṣminnaṅgānyapyasya santi hi // 246
15.d:
शंभुनाथो न्यासविधौ देवो हि कथमन्यथा ।
न्यास विवर्ज्यतेऽमुष्मिन्नङ्गान्यप्यस्य सन्ति हि ॥ 246
15.m: the lineage tradition to me according to the Śrīpūrvaśāstra: for how else could the deity / be omitted from imposition in this [rite]? For he too has limbs.

15.s:
mūrtiḥ sṛṣṭistritattvaṃ cetyaṣṭau mūrtyaṅgasaṃyutāḥ /
śivaḥ sāṅgaśca vijñeyo nyāsaḥ ṣoḍhā prakīrtitaḥ // 247
15.d:
मूर्तिः सृष्टिस्त्रितत्त्वं चेत्यष्टौ मूर्त्यङ्गसंयुताः ।
शिवः साङ्गश्च विज्ञेयो न्यासः षोढा प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 247
15.m: The Mūrti, creation, the three principles, the eight [Aghoras] accompanied by limbs of the Mūrti, / and Śiva with his limbs: the imposition is declared to be of six kinds.

15.s:
asyopari tataḥ śāktaṃ nyāsaṃ kuryācca ṣaḍvidham /
parāparāṃ savaktrāṃ prāktataḥ prāgiti mālinīm // 248
15.d:
अस्योपरि ततः शाक्तं न्यासं कुर्याच्च षड्विधम् ।
परापरां सवक्त्रां प्राक्ततः प्रागिति मालिनीम् ॥ 248
15.m: Above this, one should then perform the sixfold imposition of the Śakti [mantras]: / first Parāparā with faces, and before that the Mālinī;

15.s:
paścātparāditritayaṃ śikhāhṛtpādagaṃ kramāt /
tataḥ kavaktrakaṇṭheṣu hṛnnābhīguhya+ūrutaḥ // 249
15.d:
पश्चात्परादित्रितयं शिखाहृत्पादगं क्रमात् ।
ततः कवक्त्रकण्ठेषु हृन्नाभीगुह्य+ऊरुतः ॥ 249
15.m: afterwards the triad beginning with Parā, situated respectively on the crest, heart, and feet; / then the group of Aghoras and the rest on the head, face, throat, heart, navel, genitals, thighs,

15.s:
jānupāde'pyaghoryādyaṃ tato vidyāṅgapañcakam /
tatastvāvāhayecchaktiṃ mātṛsadbhāvarūpiṇīm // 250
15.d:
जानुपादेऽप्यघोर्याद्यं ततो विद्याङ्गपञ्चकम् ।
ततस्त्वावाहयेच्छक्तिं मातृसद्भावरूपिणीम् ॥ 250
15.m: knees, and feet; then the five limbs of Vidyā. / Then one should invoke the power having the form of the reality of the Mothers,

15.s:
yogeśvarīṃ parāṃ pūrṇāṃ kālasaṃkarṣiṇīṃ dhruvām /
aṅgavaktraparīvāraśaktidvādaśakādhikām // 251
15.d:
योगेश्वरीं परां पूर्णां कालसंकर्षिणीं ध्रुवाम् ।
अङ्गवक्त्रपरीवारशक्तिद्वादशकाधिकाम् ॥ 251
15.m: Yogeśvarī, supreme, full, Kālasaṃkarṣiṇī, firm, / possessing the twelve powers of the retinue of limbs and faces.

15.s:
sādhyānuṣṭhānabhedena nyāsakāle smaredguruḥ /
paraiva devītritayamadhye yābhedinī sthitā // 252
15.d:
साध्यानुष्ठानभेदेन न्यासकाले स्मरेद्गुरुः ।
परैव देवीत्रितयमध्ये याभेदिनी स्थिता ॥ 252
15.m: The guru should remember [her] at the time of imposition according to the division of the practice to be accomplished. / She who remains undivided among the triad of goddesses is indeed Parā alone;

15.s:
sānavacchedacinmātrasadbhāveyaṃ prakīrtitā /
sāraśāstre yāmale ca devyāstena prakīrtitaḥ // 253
15.d:
सानवच्छेदचिन्मात्रसद्भावेयं प्रकीर्तिता ।
सारशास्त्रे यामले च देव्यास्तेन प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 253
15.m: she is declared to be the unconditioned reality of pure consciousness. / Therefore, in the Sāraśāstra and in the Yāmala, the Goddess's

15.s:
mūrtiḥ savaktrā śaktiśca śaktitrayamathāṣṭakam /
pañcāṅgāni parā śaktirnyāsaḥ śākto'pi ṣaḍvidhaḥ // 254
15.d:
मूर्तिः सवक्त्रा शक्तिश्च शक्तित्रयमथाष्टकम् ।
पञ्चाङ्गानि परा शक्तिर्न्यासः शाक्तोऽपि षड्विधः ॥ 254
15.m: Mūrti with faces, Śakti, then the triad of powers, the octad, / the five limbs, and the supreme power: the imposition of Śakti is also sixfold.

15.s:
yāmalo'yaṃ mahānyāsaḥ siddhimuktiphalapradaḥ /
muktyekārthī punaḥ pūrvaṃ śāktaṃ nyāsaṃ samācaret // 255
15.d:
यामलोऽयं महान्यासः सिद्धिमुक्तिफलप्रदः ।
मुक्त्येकार्थी पुनः पूर्वं शाक्तं न्यासं समाचरेत् ॥ 255
15.m: This paired great imposition yields the fruit of spiritual accomplishment and liberation; / however, one whose sole aim is liberation should first perform the imposition of Śakti.

15.s:
guravastvāhuritthaṃ yannyāsadvayamudāhṛtam /
mumukṣuṇā tu pādādi tatkāryaṃ saṃhṛtikramāt // 256
15.d:
गुरवस्त्वाहुरित्थं यन्न्यासद्वयमुदाहृतम् ।
मुमुक्षुणा तु पादादि तत्कार्यं संहृतिक्रमात् ॥ 256
15.m: The gurus, however, say that as for this pair of impositions so explained, / by the seeker of liberation it should be performed from the feet upwards, according to the order of reabsorption.

15.s:
yāvantaḥ kīrtitā bhedāḥ śaṃbhuśaktyaṇuvācakāḥ /
tāvatsvapyeṣu mantreṣu nyāsaḥ ṣoḍhaiva kīrtitaḥ // 257
15.d:
यावन्तः कीर्तिता भेदाः शंभुशक्त्यणुवाचकाः ।
तावत्स्वप्येषु मन्त्रेषु न्यासः षोढैव कीर्तितः ॥ 257
15.m: As many varieties as are proclaimed denoting Śambhu, Śakti, and the bound soul, / even among all those mantras the imposition is proclaimed to be precisely of six kinds.

15.s:
kiṃtvāvāhyastu yo mantraḥ sa tatrāṅgasamanvitaḥ /
ṣaṣṭhaḥ syāditi sarvatra ṣoḍhaivāyamudāhṛtaḥ // 258
15.d:
किंत्वावाह्यस्तु यो मन्त्रः स तत्राङ्गसमन्वितः ।
षष्ठः स्यादिति सर्वत्र षोढैवायमुदाहृतः ॥ 258
15.m: However, the mantra that is to be invoked, accompanied by its limbs, / becomes the sixth; thus everywhere this is taught as sixfold alone.

15.s:
mudrāpradarśanaṃ paścātkāyena manasā girā /
pañcāvasthā jāgradādyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyanuttaranāmikā // 259
15.d:
मुद्राप्रदर्शनं पश्चात्कायेन मनसा गिरा ।
पञ्चावस्था जाग्रदाद्याः षष्ठ्यनुत्तरनामिका ॥ 259
15.m: Afterwards comes the showing of mudrās by body, mind, and speech. / The five states are waking and the rest; the sixth is named the unexcelled.

15.s:
ṣaṭkāraṇaṣaḍātmatvātṣaṭtriṃśattattvayojanam /
evaṃ ṣoḍhāmahānyāse kṛte viśvamidaṃ haṭhāt // 260
15.d:
षट्कारणषडात्मत्वात्षट्त्रिंशत्तत्त्वयोजनम् ।
एवं षोढामहान्यासे कृते विश्वमिदं हठात् ॥ 260
15.m: Because of having six causes and six selves, there is the integration of the thirty-six principles. / When the great sixfold imposition has thus been performed, this universe forcibly [becomes pure consciousness].

15.s:
dehe tādātmyamāpannaṃ śuddhāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ prakāśayet /
mūrtinyāsātsamārabhya yā sṛṣṭiḥ prasṛtātra sā // 261
15.d:
देहे तादात्म्यमापन्नं शुद्धां सृष्टिं प्रकाशयेत् ।
मूर्तिन्यासात्समारभ्य या सृष्टिः प्रसृतात्र सा ॥ 261
15.m: identified with the body, should manifest pure creation. / The creation that extended here, beginning from the ritual placement of forms, // 261

15.s:
abhedamānīya kṛtā śuddhā nyāsabalakramāt /
tena ye'codayanmūḍhāḥ pāśadāhavidhūnane // 262
15.d:
अभेदमानीय कृता शुद्धा न्यासबलक्रमात् ।
तेन येऽचोदयन्मूढाः पाशदाहविधूनने ॥ 262
15.m: has been rendered pure by being brought to non-duality through the power of sequential ritual placement. / Therefore, the fools who objected: “When the burning and shaking off of the bonds // 262

15.s:
kṛte śānte śive rūḍhaḥ punaḥ kimavarohati /
iti te dūrato dhvastāḥ paramārthaṃ hi śāṃbhavam // 263
15.d:
कृते शान्ते शिवे रूढः पुनः किमवरोहति ।
इति ते दूरतो ध्वस्ताः परमार्थं हि शांभवम् ॥ 263
15.m: has been performed, why does one who has ascended to tranquil Śiva descend again?” / — they have been cast far away, for the supreme reality of Śiva // 263

15.s:
na vidusta svasaṃvittisphurattāsāravarjitāḥ /
na khalveṣa śivaḥ śānto nāma kaścidvibhedavān // 264
15.d:
न विदुस्त स्वसंवित्तिस्फुरत्तासारवर्जिताः ।
न खल्वेष शिवः शान्तो नाम कश्चिद्विभेदवान् ॥ 264
15.m: they do not know, lacking the essence of the vibrant radiance of self-consciousness. / Indeed, this so-called tranquil Śiva is not something differentiated, // 264

15.s:
sarvetarādhvavyāvṛtto ghaṭatulyo'sti kutracit /
mahāprakāśarūpā hi yeyaṃ saṃvidvijṛmbhate // 265
15.d:
सर्वेतराध्वव्यावृत्तो घटतुल्योऽस्ति कुत्रचित् ।
महाप्रकाशरूपा हि येयं संविद्विजृम्भते ॥ 265
15.m: excluded from every other path and existing somewhere like a jar. / For this consciousness that expands in the form of the Great Luminosity — // 265

15.s:
sa śivaḥ śivataivāsya vaiśvarūpyāvabhāsitā /
tathābhāsanayogo'taḥ svarasenāsya jṛmbhate // 266
15.d:
स शिवः शिवतैवास्य वैश्वरूप्यावभासिता ।
तथाभासनयोगोऽतः स्वरसेनास्य जृम्भते ॥ 266
15.m: that is Śiva; and his being Śiva is precisely the manifestation of all forms. / Therefore, the application of such manifestation expands by his spontaneous nature. // 266

15.s:
bhāsyamāno'tra cābhedaḥ svātmano bheda eva ca /
bhede vijṛmbhite māyā māyāmāturvijṛmbhate // 267
15.d:
भास्यमानोऽत्र चाभेदः स्वात्मनो भेद एव च ।
भेदे विजृम्भिते माया मायामातुर्विजृम्भते ॥ 267
15.m: And here, both non-duality and duality of oneself are manifested. / When duality expands, māyā expands for the subject of māyā; // 267

15.s:
abhede jṛmbhate'syaiva māyāmātuḥ śivātmatā /
māyāpramātā tadrūpavikalpābhyāsapāṭavāt // 268
15.d:
अभेदे जृम्भतेऽस्यैव मायामातुः शिवात्मता ।
मायाप्रमाता तद्रूपविकल्पाभ्यासपाटवात् ॥ 268
15.m: when non-duality expands, the nature of Śiva expands for this very subject of māyā. / The knowing subject of māyā, through proficiency in cultivating the conceptual constructs of that [divine] nature, // 268

15.s:
śiva eva tadabhyāsaphalaṃ nyāsādi kīrtitam /
yathāhi duṣṭakarmāsmītyevaṃ bhāvayatastathā // 269
15.d:
शिव एव तदभ्यासफलं न्यासादि कीर्तितम् ।
यथाहि दुष्टकर्मास्मीत्येवं भावयतस्तथा ॥ 269
15.m: is Śiva himself; ritual placement and the like are declared to be the fruit of that practice. / For just as when one meditates, “I am an evil-doer,” it is so, // 269

15.s:
tathā śivo'haṃ nānyo'smītyevaṃ bhāvayatastathā /
etadevocyate dārḍhyaṃ vimarśahṛdayaṅgamam // 270
15.d:
तथा शिवोऽहं नान्योऽस्मीत्येवं भावयतस्तथा ।
एतदेवोच्यते दार्ढ्यं विमर्शहृदयङ्गमम् ॥ 270
15.m: so when one meditates, “I am Śiva, I am no other,” it is so. / Just this is declared to be the firmness that penetrates the heart of reflective awareness: // 270

15.s:
śivaikātmyavikalpaughadvārikā nirvikalpatā /
anyathā tasya śuddhasya vimarśaprāṇavartinaḥ // 271
15.d:
शिवैकात्म्यविकल्पौघद्वारिका निर्विकल्पता ।
अन्यथा तस्य शुद्धस्य विमर्शप्राणवर्तिनः ॥ 271
15.m: the non-conceptual state whose gateway is the flood of conceptual constructs of identity with Śiva. / Otherwise, for that pure reality whose life consists in reflective awareness // 271

15.s:
kathaṃ nāmāvimṛṣṭaṃ syādrūpaṃ bhāsanadharmaṇaḥ /
tenātidurghaṭaghaṭāsvatantrecchāvaśādayam // 272
15.d:
कथं नामाविमृष्टं स्याद्रूपं भासनधर्मणः ।
तेनातिदुर्घटघटास्वतन्त्रेच्छावशादयम् ॥ 272
15.m: and whose nature is illumination, how indeed could its nature remain unreflected upon? / Therefore, by the power of his free will that accomplishes what is most difficult to accomplish, // 272

15.s:
bhānapi prāṇabuddhyādiḥ svaṃ tathā na vikalpayet /
pratyutātisvatantrātmaviparītasvadharmatām // 273
15.d:
भानपि प्राणबुद्ध्यादिः स्वं तथा न विकल्पयेत् ।
प्रत्युतातिस्वतन्त्रात्मविपरीतस्वधर्मताम् ॥ 273
15.m: though shining, this [individual self], consisting of breath, intellect, and the like, does not conceptually construct itself as such. / On the contrary, having determined its own condition to be contrary to its supremely autonomous self, // 273

15.s:
vināśyanīśāyattatvarūpāṃ niścitya majjati /
tataḥ saṃsārabhāgīyatathāniścayaśātinīm // 274
15.d:
विनाश्यनीशायत्तत्वरूपां निश्चित्य मज्जति ।
ततः संसारभागीयतथानिश्चयशातिनीम् ॥ 274
15.m: consisting of perishability and dependence on another, it sinks [in transmigratory existence]. / Therefore, one should resort to the non-conceptual state, destroying such determinations belonging to saṃsāra, // 274

15.s:
nityādiniścayadvārāmavikalpāṃ sthitiṃ śrayet /
ye tu tīvratamodriktaśaktinirmalatājuṣaḥ // 275
15.d:
नित्यादिनिश्चयद्वारामविकल्पां स्थितिं श्रयेत् ।
ये तु तीव्रतमोद्रिक्तशक्तिनिर्मलताजुषः ॥ 275
15.m: by means of determinations such as eternity and the like. / Those, however, who enjoy the purity of the intensely heightened power [of grace] — // 275

15.s:
na te dīkṣāmanunyāsakāriṇaśceti varṇitam /
evaṃ viśvaśarīraḥ sanviśvātmatvaṃ gataḥ sphuṭam // 276
15.d:
न ते दीक्षामनुन्यासकारिणश्चेति वर्णितम् ।
एवं विश्वशरीरः सन्विश्वात्मत्वं गतः स्फुटम् ॥ 276
15.m: they do not perform initiation or subsequent ritual placement, as has been explained. / Thus, having the universe as his body and having clearly attained the nature of the universal Self // 276

15.s:
nyāsamātrāt tathābhūtaṃ dehaṃ puṣpādinārcayet /
pṛthaṅmantrairvistareṇa saṃkṣepānmūlamantrataḥ // 277
15.d:
न्यासमात्रात् तथाभूतं देहं पुष्पादिनार्चयेत् ।
पृथङ्मन्त्रैर्विस्तरेण संक्षेपान्मूलमन्त्रतः ॥ 277
15.m: merely through ritual placement, he should worship the body transformed in this manner with flowers and the like, / in detail with individual mantras, and concisely with the root mantra; // 277

15.s:
dhūpanaivedyatṛptyādyaistathā vyāsasamāsataḥ /
saṃsāravāmācāratvātsarvaṃ vāmakareṇa tu // 278
15.d:
धूपनैवेद्यतृप्त्याद्यैस्तथा व्याससमासतः ।
संसारवामाचारत्वात्सर्वं वामकरेण तु ॥ 278
15.m: likewise, in expanded or condensed form, with incense, food offerings, libations, and the like. / Because of transmigratory existence being reversed, the master // 278

15.s:
kuryāttarpaṇayogaṃ ca daiśikastadanāmayā /
vāmaśabdena guhyaṃ śrīmataṅgādāvapīritam // 279
15.d:
कुर्यात्तर्पणयोगं च दैशिकस्तदनामया ।
वामशब्देन गुह्यं श्रीमतङ्गादावपीरितम् ॥ 279
15.m: should perform everything with the left hand, and the practice of libation with the ring finger. / The secret has also been declared in the venerable Mataṅga and other texts by the word vāma; // 279

15.s:
vāmācāraparo mantrī yāgaṃ kuryāditi sphuṭam /
śrīmadbhargaśikhāśāstre tathā śrīgamaśāsane // 280
15.d:
वामाचारपरो मन्त्री यागं कुर्यादिति स्फुटम् ।
श्रीमद्भर्गशिखाशास्त्रे तथा श्रीगमशासने ॥ 280
15.m: it is clearly taught that the practitioner devoted to the left-hand ritual should perform the sacrifice / in the venerable Bhargaśikhā treatise, and likewise in the venerable Gamaśāsana: // 280

15.s:
sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam /
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitamanāmātarpaṇātpriye // 281
15.d:
सर्वतीर्थेषु यत्पुण्यं सर्वयज्ञेषु यत्फलम् ।
तत्फलं कोटिगुणितमनामातर्पणात्प्रिये ॥ 281
15.m: “Whatever merit there is in all holy places, whatever fruit in all sacrifices, / that fruit is multiplied ten million times, O beloved, by offering libation with the ring finger.” // 281

15.s:
śrīmannandiśikhāyāṃ ca śrīmadānandaśāsane /
taduktaṃ srukca pūrṇāyāṃ sruvaścājyāhutau bhavet // 282
15.d:
श्रीमन्नन्दिशिखायां च श्रीमदानन्दशासने ।
तदुक्तं स्रुक्च पूर्णायां स्रुवश्चाज्याहुतौ भवेत् ॥ 282
15.m: And in the venerable Nandiśikhā and the venerable Ānandaśāsana / that has been stated: “The offering spoon is for the full oblation, and the ladle is for the oblation of clarified butter; // 282

15.s:
śeṣaṃ vāmakareṇaiva pūjāhomajapādikam /
evamānandasaṃpūrṇaṃ sarvaunmukhyavivarjitam // 283
15.d:
शेषं वामकरेणैव पूजाहोमजपादिकम् ।
एवमानन्दसंपूर्णं सर्वौन्मुख्यविवर्जितम् ॥ 283
15.m: the rest, such as worship, fire offering, recitation, and the like, is done with the left hand alone.” / Thus, having accomplished through sacrifice the body filled with bliss // 283

15.s:
yāgena dehaṃ miṣpādya bhāvayeta śivātmakam /
galite viṣayaunmukhye pārimitye vilāpite // 284
15.d:
यागेन देहं मिष्पाद्य भावयेत शिवात्मकम् ।
गलिते विषयौन्मुख्ये पारिमित्ये विलापिते ॥ 284
15.m: and devoid of all outward directedness, one should contemplate it as identical with Śiva. / When outward directedness toward objects has dissolved and limitation has been eliminated, // 284

15.s:
dehe kimavaśiṣyeta śivānandarasādṛte /
śivānandarasāpūrṇaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvanirbharam // 285
15.d:
देहे किमवशिष्येत शिवानन्दरसादृते ।
शिवानन्दरसापूर्णं षट्त्रिंशत्तत्त्वनिर्भरम् ॥ 285
15.m: what could remain in the body except the nectar of the bliss of Śiva? / Seeing day and night the body filled with the nectar of the bliss of Śiva, // 285

15.s:
dehaṃ divāniśaṃ paśyannarcayansyācchivātmakaḥ /
viśvātmadehaviśrāntitṛptastalliṅganiṣṭhitaḥ // 286
15.d:
देहं दिवानिशं पश्यन्नर्चयन्स्याच्छिवात्मकः ।
विश्वात्मदेहविश्रान्तितृप्तस्तल्लिङ्गनिष्ठितः ॥ 286
15.m: replete with the thirty-six principles of reality, and worshipping it, he becomes identical with Śiva. / Satisfied through resting in the body that is the universal Self, established in that liṅga, // 286

15.s:
bāhyaṃ liṅgavratakṣetracaryādi nahi vāñchati /
tāvanmātrāttvaviśrānteḥ saṃvidaḥ kathitāḥ kriyāḥ // 287
15.d:
बाह्यं लिङ्गव्रतक्षेत्रचर्यादि नहि वाञ्छति ।
तावन्मात्रात्त्वविश्रान्तेः संविदः कथिताः क्रियाः ॥ 287
15.m: he does not desire an external liṅga, vow, pilgrimage place, ascetic practice, and the like. / Ritual actions, however, have been taught because consciousness does not rest by that alone, // 287

15.s:
uttarā bāhyayāgāntāḥ sādhyā tvatra śivātmatā /
tato'rghapātraṃ kartavyaṃ śivābhedamayaṃ param // 288
15.d:
उत्तरा बाह्ययागान्ताः साध्या त्वत्र शिवात्मता ।
ततोऽर्घपात्रं कर्तव्यं शिवाभेदमयं परम् ॥ 288
15.m: subsequent ones culminating in external sacrifice; but here the goal to be attained is identity with Śiva. / Then the supreme vessel of offering should be prepared, consisting in non-duality with Śiva, // 288

15.s:
ānandarasasaṃpūrṇaṃ viśvadaivatatarpaṇam /
yathaiva dehe dāhādipūjāntaṃ tadvadeva hi // 289
15.d:
आनन्दरससंपूर्णं विश्वदैवततर्पणम् ।
यथैव देहे दाहादिपूजान्तं तद्वदेव हि ॥ 289
15.m: filled with the nectar of bliss, which propitiates all the deities. / Just as in the body from burning up to worship, in the very same way // 289

15.s:
arghapātre'pi kartavyaṃ samāsavyāsayogataḥ /
kāni dravyāṇi yāgāya ko nvargha iti noditam // 290
15.d:
अर्घपात्रेऽपि कर्तव्यं समासव्यासयोगतः ।
कानि द्रव्याणि यागाय को न्वर्घ इति नोदितम् ॥ 290
15.m: it should be performed also in the offering vessel through condensed and expanded methods. / What substances are for sacrifice, and what indeed is the offering, has not been restricted: // 290

15.s:
siddhikāmasya tatsiddhau sādhanaiva hi kāraṇam /
muktikāmasya no kiṃcinniṣiddhaṃ vihitaṃ ca no // 291
15.d:
सिद्धिकामस्य तत्सिद्धौ साधनैव हि कारणम् ।
मुक्तिकामस्य नो किंचिन्निषिद्धं विहितं च नो ॥ 291
15.m: for one desiring spiritual accomplishment, the means itself is the cause in attaining that accomplishment; / for one desiring liberation, nothing is prohibited and nothing is prescribed. // 291

15.s:
yadeva hṛdyaṃ tadyogyaṃ śivasaṃvidabhedane /
kṛtvārghapātraṃ tadvipruṭprokṣitaṃ kusumādikam // 292
15.d:
यदेव हृद्यं तद्योग्यं शिवसंविदभेदने ।
कृत्वार्घपात्रं तद्विप्रुट्प्रोक्षितं कुसुमादिकम् ॥ 292
15.m: Whatever is delightful to the heart is suitable in bringing about non-duality with Śiva-consciousness. / Having prepared the offering vessel and having sprinkled flowers and the like with drops from it, // 292

15.s:
kṛtvā ca tena svātmānaṃ pūjayetparamaṃ śivam /
arghapātrārcanādattapuṣpasaṃkīrṇatābhayāt // 293
15.d:
कृत्वा च तेन स्वात्मानं पूजयेत्परमं शिवम् ।
अर्घपात्रार्चनादत्तपुष्पसंकीर्णताभयात् ॥ 293
15.m: and with that, one should worship one's own Self, the supreme Śiva. / For fear of confusion caused by flowers presented in the worship of the offering vessel, // 293

15.s:
nārghapātre'tra kusumaṃ kuryāddevārcanākṛte /
arghapātre tadamṛtībhūtamambveva pūjitam // 294
15.d:
नार्घपात्रेऽत्र कुसुमं कुर्याद्देवार्चनाकृते ।
अर्घपात्रे तदमृतीभूतमम्ब्वेव पूजितम् ॥ 294
15.m: one should not place a flower in the offering vessel here for the worship of the deity; / the water alone in the offering vessel, transformed into nectar, is worshipped, // 294

15.s:
mantrāṇāṃ tṛptaye yāgadravyaśuddhyai ca kevalam /
evaṃ dehaṃ pūjayitvā prāṇadhīśūnyavigrahān // 295
15.d:
मन्त्राणां तृप्तये यागद्रव्यशुद्ध्यै च केवलम् ।
एवं देहं पूजयित्वा प्राणधीशून्यविग्रहान् ॥ 295
15.m: solely for the satisfaction of the mantras and for the purification of the sacrificial substances. / Having thus worshipped the body, one should worship the embodiments of breath, intellect, and the void, // 295

15.s:
anyonyatanmayībhūtān pūjayecchivatādṛśe /
tatra prāṇāśraye nayāse buddhyā viracite sati // 296
15.d:
अन्योन्यतन्मयीभूतान् पूजयेच्छिवतादृशे ।
तत्र प्राणाश्रये नयासे बुद्ध्या विरचिते सति ॥ 296
15.m: which have become mutually identified with each other, in such state of Śiva. / There, when the ritual placement supported by breath has been fashioned through the intellect, // 296

15.s:
śūnyādhiṣṭhānataḥ sarvamekayatnena pūjyate /
nyasyedādhāraśaktiṃ tu nābhyadhaścaturaṅgulām // 297
15.d:
शून्याधिष्ठानतः सर्वमेकयत्नेन पूज्यते ।
न्यस्येदाधारशक्तिं तु नाभ्यधश्चतुरङ्गुलाम् ॥ 297
15.m: everything is worshipped with a single effort on account of the substrate of the void. / One should place the power of the support four finger-breadths below the navel; // 297

15.s:
dharāṃ surodaṃ tejaśca meyapārapratiṣṭhiteḥ /
potarūpaṃ marutkandasvabhāvaṃ viśvasūtraṇāt // 298
15.d:
धरां सुरोदं तेजश्च मेयपारप्रतिष्ठितेः ।
पोतरूपं मरुत्कन्दस्वभावं विश्वसूत्रणात् ॥ 298
15.m: earth, the ocean of wine, and fire, because of establishing the limit of knowable objects; / having the form of a boat, possessing the nature of the bulb of wind, because of weaving the universe together — // 298

15.s:
pratyekamaṅgulaṃ nyasyeccatuṣkaṃ vyomagarbhakam /
īṣatsamantādamalamidamāmalasārakam // 299
15.d:
प्रत्येकमङ्गुलं न्यस्येच्चतुष्कं व्योमगर्भकम् ।
ईषत्समन्तादमलमिदमामलसारकम् ॥ 299
15.m: one should place this group of four containing ether within it, one finger-breadth each, / slightly pure on all sides, like a myrobalan fruit. // 299

15.s:
tato daṇḍamanantākhyaṃ kalpayellambikāvadhi /
tanmātrādikalāntaṃ tadūrdhve granthirniśātmakaḥ // 300
15.d:
ततो दण्डमनन्ताख्यं कल्पयेल्लम्बिकावधि ।
तन्मात्रादिकलान्तं तदूर्ध्वे ग्रन्थिर्निशात्मकः ॥ 300
15.m: Then one should fashion the stalk named Ananta up to the uvula; / it extends from the subtle elements up to kalā, and above it is the knot whose nature is night. // 300

15.s:
tatra māyāmaye granthau dharmādharmādyamaṣṭakam /
vahniprāgādi māyā hi tatsūtirvibhavastu dhīḥ // 301
15.d:
तत्र मायामये ग्रन्थौ धर्माधर्माद्यमष्टकम् ।
वह्निप्रागादि माया हि तत्सूतिर्विभवस्तु धीः ॥ 301
15.m: There, in that knot consisting of māyā, is the group of eight beginning with virtue and vice, / from fire, east, and the rest; for māyā is their source, while their expansion is the intellect. // 301

15.s:
māyāgrantherūrdhvabhūmau triśūlādhaścatuṣkikām /
śuddhavidyātmikāṃ dhyāyecchadanadvayasaṃyutām // 302
15.d:
मायाग्रन्थेरूर्ध्वभूमौ त्रिशूलाधश्चतुष्किकाम् ।
शुद्धविद्यात्मिकां ध्यायेच्छदनद्वयसंयुताम् ॥ 302
15.m: In the region above the knot of māyā, below the trident, one should contemplate the fourfold seat / consisting of Pure Knowledge, endowed with two covers. // 302

15.s:
tacca tattvaṃ sthitaṃ bhāvyaṃ lambikābrahmarandhrayoḥ /
prakāśayogo hyatraivaṃ dṛkśrotrarasanādikaḥ // 303
15.d:
तच्च तत्त्वं स्थितं भाव्यं लम्बिकाब्रह्मरन्ध्रयोः ।
प्रकाशयोगो ह्यत्रैवं दृक्श्रोत्ररसनादिकः ॥ 303
15.m: And that principle of reality should be meditated upon as stationed between the uvula and the aperture of Brahman; / for here alone occurs the conjunction of luminosity such as sight, hearing, taste, and the rest. // 303

15.s:
dakṣānyāvartato nyasyecchaktīnāṃ navakadvayam /
vidyāpadme'tra taccoktamapi prāgdarśyate punaḥ // 304
15.d:
दक्षान्यावर्ततो न्यस्येच्छक्तीनां नवकद्वयम् ।
विद्यापद्मेऽत्र तच्चोक्तमपि प्राग्दर्श्यते पुनः ॥ 304
15.m: By turning clockwise and otherwise, one should place two sets of nine powers / here on the lotus of Vidyā; and although that has been explained, it is shown again: // 304

15.s:
vāmā jyeṣṭhā raudrī kālī kalabalavikarike balamathanī /
bhūtadamanī ca manonmanikā śāntā śakracāparuciratra syāt // 305
15.d:
वामा ज्येष्ठा रौद्री काली कलबलविकरिके बलमथनी ।
भूतदमनी च मनोन्मनिका शान्ता शक्रचापरुचिरत्र स्यात् ॥ 305
15.m: Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, Raudrī, Kālī, Kalabalavikarikā, Balamathanī, / Bhūtadamanī, Manonmanikā, and Śāntā, having the brilliance of a rainbow here; // 305

15.s:
vibhvī jñaptikṛtīcchā vāgīśī jvālinī tathā vāmā /
jyeṣṭhā raudrītyetāḥ prāgdalataḥ kāladahanavatsarvāḥ // 306
15.d:
विभ्वी ज्ञप्तिकृतीच्छा वागीशी ज्वालिनी तथा वामा ।
ज्येष्ठा रौद्रीत्येताः प्राग्दलतः कालदहनवत्सर्वाः ॥ 306
15.m: Vibhvī, Jñapti, Kriyā, Icchā, Vāgīśī, Jvālinī, and likewise Vāmā, / Jyeṣṭhā, and Raudrī — all these, starting from the eastern petal, are like the fire of Time. // 306

15.s:
dalakesaramadhyeṣu sūryendudahanatrayam /
nijādhipairbrahmaviṣṇuharaiścādhiṣṭhitaṃ smaret // 307
15.d:
दलकेसरमध्येषु सूर्येन्दुदहनत्रयम् ।
निजाधिपैर्ब्रह्मविष्णुहरैश्चाधिष्ठितं स्मरेत् ॥ 307
15.m: In the petals, filaments, and center, one should remember the triad of sun, moon, and fire, / presided over by their own lords: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Hara.

15.s:
māyottīrṇaṃ hi yadrūpaṃ brahmādīnāṃ puroditam /
āsanaṃ tvetadeva syānnatu māyāñjanāñjitam // 308
15.d:
मायोत्तीर्णं हि यद्रूपं ब्रह्मादीनां पुरोदितम् ।
आसनं त्वेतदेव स्यान्नतु मायाञ्जनाञ्जितम् ॥ 308
15.m: For that form of Brahmā and the others which was mentioned earlier as transcending Māyā, / that alone can be the seat, and not [one] smeared with the collyrium of Māyā.

15.s:
rudrordhve ceśvaraṃ devaṃ tadūrdhve ca sadāśivam /
nyasyetsa ca mahāpreta iti śāstreṣu bhaṇyate // 309
15.d:
रुद्रोर्ध्वे चेश्वरं देवं तदूर्ध्वे च सदाशिवम् ।
न्यस्येत्स च महाप्रेत इति शास्त्रेषु भण्यते ॥ 309
15.m: Above Rudra one should install the god Īśvara, and above him Sadāśiva; / and he is spoken of in the scriptures as the great corpse (mahāpreta).

15.s:
samastatattvavyāptṛtvānmahāpretaḥ prabodhataḥ /
prakarṣagamanāccaiṣa līno yannādharaṃ vrajet // 310
15.d:
समस्ततत्त्वव्याप्तृत्वान्महाप्रेतः प्रबोधतः ।
प्रकर्षगमनाच्चैष लीनो यन्नाधरं व्रजेत् ॥ 310
15.m: He is the great corpse because he pervades all the principles, because he has attained preeminence through awakening, / and because, being dissolved, he does not descend to what is lower.

15.s:
vidyāvidyeśinaḥ sarve hyuttarottaratāṃ gatāḥ /
sadāśivībhūya tataḥ paraṃ śivamupāśritāḥ // 311
15.d:
विद्याविद्येशिनः सर्वे ह्युत्तरोत्तरतां गताः ।
सदाशिवीभूय ततः परं शिवमुपाश्रिताः ॥ 311
15.m: For all the Vidyās and Lords of Vidyā, having attained higher and higher degrees, / have become Sadāśiva, and from there have taken refuge in the supreme Śiva.

15.s:
ataḥ sadāśivo nityamūrdhvadṛgbhāsvarātmakaḥ /
kṛśo meyatvadaurbalyātpreto'ṭṭahasanāditaḥ // 312
15.d:
अतः सदाशिवो नित्यमूर्ध्वदृग्भास्वरात्मकः ।
कृशो मेयत्वदौर्बल्यात्प्रेतोऽट्टहसनादितः ॥ 312
15.m: Therefore Sadāśiva is eternally luminous with his upward gaze; / he is emaciated through the weakness of being an object of cognition, and a corpse (preta) from resounding with loud laughter and the like.

15.s:
tasya nābhyutthitaṃ mūrdharandhratrayavinirgatam /
nādāntātma smarecchaktivyāpinīsamanojjvalam // 313
15.d:
तस्य नाभ्युत्थितं मूर्धरन्ध्रत्रयविनिर्गतम् ।
नादान्तात्म स्मरेच्छक्तिव्यापिनीसमनोज्ज्वलम् ॥ 313
15.m: One should contemplate [the seat] arising from his navel, emerging through the three cranial openings, / having the nature of Nādānta, and resplendent with Śakti, Vyāpinī, and Samanā.

15.s:
arātrayaṃ dviṣaṭkāntaṃ tatrāpyaunmanasaṃ trayam /
paṅkajānāṃ sitaṃ saptatriṃśadātmedamāsanam // 314
15.d:
अरात्रयं द्विषट्कान्तं तत्राप्यौन्मनसं त्रयम् ।
पङ्कजानां सितं सप्तत्रिंशदात्मेदमासनम् ॥ 314
15.m: There is a triad of spokes extending up to the twelfth; therein also is the Unmanā-triad / of white lotuses: this seat consists of the thirty-seven [principles].

15.s:
atra sarvāṇi tattvāni bhedaprāṇāni yattataḥ /
āsanatvena bhinnaṃ hi saṃvido viṣayaḥ smṛtaḥ // 315
15.d:
अत्र सर्वाणि तत्त्वानि भेदप्राणानि यत्ततः ।
आसनत्वेन भिन्नं हि संविदो विषयः स्मृतः ॥ 315
15.m: Here, since all principles have differentiation as their vital breath, / that which is differentiated is indeed taught to be the object of consciousness in the manner of a seat.

15.s:
etānyeva tu tattvāni līnāni parabhairave /
tādātmyenātha sṛṣṭāni bhidevārcyatvayojane // 316
15.d:
एतान्येव तु तत्त्वानि लीनानि परभैरवे ।
तादात्म्येनाथ सृष्टानि भिदेवार्च्यत्वयोजने ॥ 316
15.m: These very principles, however, dissolved in the supreme Bhairava / through identity, or emitted, are indeed differentiated when joined to worshipfulness.

15.s:
śrīmadbhairavabodhaikyalābhasvātantryavanti tu /
etānyeva tu tattvāni pūjakatvaṃ prayāntyalam // 317
15.d:
श्रीमद्भैरवबोधैक्यलाभस्वातन्त्र्यवन्ति तु ।
एतान्येव तु तत्त्वानि पूजकत्वं प्रयान्त्यलम् ॥ 317
15.m: Possessing absolute autonomy through gaining unity with the awareness of the venerable Bhairava, / these very principles fully attain the state of being the worshipper.

15.s:
pūjakaḥ paratattvātmā pūjyaṃ tattvaṃ parāparam /
sṛṣṭatvādaparaṃ tattvajālamāsanatāspadam // 318
15.d:
पूजकः परतत्त्वात्मा पूज्यं तत्त्वं परापरम् ।
सृष्टत्वादपरं तत्त्वजालमासनतास्पदम् ॥ 318
15.m: The worshipper has the nature of the supreme principle; the worshipped is the supreme-cum-non-supreme principle; / and because it is emitted, the multitude of non-supreme principles is the locus of being the seat.

15.s:
vidyākalāntaṃ siddhānte vāmadakṣiṇaśāstrayoḥ /
sadāśivāntaṃ samanāparyantaṃ matayāmale // 319
15.d:
विद्याकलान्तं सिद्धान्ते वामदक्षिणशास्त्रयोः ।
सदाशिवान्तं समनापर्यन्तं मतयामले ॥ 319
15.m: In the Siddhānta, it extends up to the Vidyākalā; in the Vāma and Dakṣiṇa scriptures, / up to Sadāśiva; in the Mata[tantra] and Yāmala, up to Samanā;

15.s:
unmanāntamihākhyātamityetatparamāsanam /
arcayitvāsanaṃ pūjyā gurupaṅktistu bhāvivat // 320
15.d:
उन्मनान्तमिहाख्यातमित्येतत्परमासनम् ।
अर्चयित्वासनं पूज्या गुरुपङ्क्तिस्तु भाविवत् ॥ 320
15.m: here it is declared to extend up to Unmanā. Thus this is the supreme seat. / Having worshipped the seat, the row of gurus is to be worshipped, as will be explained.

15.s:
tatrāsane purā mūrtibhūtāṃ sārdhākṣarāṃ dvayīm /
nyasyedvyāptṛtayetyuktaṃ siddhayogīśvarīmate // 321
15.d:
तत्रासने पुरा मूर्तिभूतां सार्धाक्षरां द्वयीम् ।
न्यस्येद्व्याप्तृतयेत्युक्तं सिद्धयोगीश्वरीमते ॥ 321
15.m: There on that seat, one should first install the two-and-a-half-syllable [mantra] as the embodied form / by way of its pervading nature; thus it is taught in the Siddhayogīśvarīmata.

15.s:
sadāśivaṃ mahāpretaṃ mūrtiṃ sārdhākṣarāṃ yajet /
paratvena parāmūrdhve gandhapuṣpādibhistviti // 322
15.d:
सदाशिवं महाप्रेतं मूर्तिं सार्धाक्षरां यजेत् ।
परत्वेन परामूर्ध्वे गन्धपुष्पादिभिस्त्विति ॥ 322
15.m: One should worship the great corpse Sadāśiva as the form, and the two-and-a-half-syllable [mantra], / and Parā above, as supreme, with fragrant incense, flowers, and so forth.

15.s:
vidyāmūrtimathātmākhyāṃ dvitīyāṃ parikalpayet /
madhye bhairavasadbhāvaṃ dakṣiṇe ratiśekharam // 323
15.d:
विद्यामूर्तिमथात्माख्यां द्वितीयां परिकल्पयेत् ।
मध्ये भैरवसद्भावं दक्षिणे रतिशेखरम् ॥ 323
15.m: Then one should mentally project the Vidyā-body called the Self as the second: / Bhairavasadbhāva in the center, Ratiśekhara on the right,

15.s:
navātmānaṃ vāmatastaddevīvadbhairavatrayam /
madhye parāṃ pūrṇacandrapratimāṃ dakṣiṇe punaḥ // 324
15.d:
नवात्मानं वामतस्तद्देवीवद्भैरवत्रयम् ।
मध्ये परां पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतिमां दक्षिणे पुनः ॥ 324
15.m: and Navātman on the left—that is the triad of Bhairavas, corresponding to the Goddesses: / in the center Parā, resembling the full moon; then on the right,

15.s:
parāparāṃ raktavarṇāṃ kiṃcidagrāṃ na bhīṣaṇām /
aparāṃ vāmaśṛṅge tu bhīṣaṇāṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgalām // 325
15.d:
परापरां रक्तवर्णां किंचिदग्रां न भीषणाम् ।
अपरां वामशृङ्गे तु भीषणां कृष्णपिङ्गलाम् ॥ 325
15.m: Parāparā, red in color, slightly fierce, not terrifying; / and on the left prong, Aparā, terrifying and dark brown.

15.s:
prāgvaddvidhātra ṣoḍhaiva nyāso dehe yathā kṛtaḥ /
tataḥ sāṃkalpikaṃ yuktaṃ vapurāsāṃ vicintayet // 326
15.d:
प्राग्वद्द्विधात्र षोढैव न्यासो देहे यथा कृतः ।
ततः सांकल्पिकं युक्तं वपुरासां विचिन्तयेत् ॥ 326
15.m: The installation (nyāsa) is made in the body in two ways, just as before, in sixfold manner alone; / then one should meditate on their appropriate mental form:

15.s:
kṛtyabhedānusāreṇa dvicatuḥṣaḍbhujādikam /
kapālaśūlakhaṭvāṅgavarābhayaghaṭādikam // 327
15.d:
कृत्यभेदानुसारेण द्विचतुःषड्भुजादिकम् ।
कपालशूलखट्वाङ्गवराभयघटादिकम् ॥ 327
15.m: having two, four, six arms, and so forth, according to the distinction of actions; / [bearing] a skull-cup, trident, skull-staff, boon-giving, fear-dispelling gesture, pot, and so on,

15.s:
vāmadakṣiṇasaṃsthānacitratvātparikalpayet /
vastuto viśvarūpāstā devyo bodhātmikā yataḥ // 328
15.d:
वामदक्षिणसंस्थानचित्रत्वात्परिकल्पयेत् ।
वस्तुतो विश्वरूपास्ता देव्यो बोधात्मिका यतः ॥ 328
15.m: one should visualize [them] due to the variety of left and right configurations. / In truth, those Goddesses are omnipresent, since they consist of awareness.

15.s:
anavacchinnacinmātrasārāḥ syurapavṛktaye /
sarvaṃ tato'ṅgavaktrādi lokapālāstrapaścimam // 329
15.d:
अनवच्छिन्नचिन्मात्रसाराः स्युरपवृक्तये ।
सर्वं ततोऽङ्गवक्त्रादि लोकपालास्त्रपश्चिमम् ॥ 329
15.m: Their essence is pure unconditioned consciousness, for the purpose of liberation. / Then everything—limbs, faces, and so forth, ending with the guardians of the directions and their weapons—[is worshipped].

15.s:
madhye devyabhidhā pūjyā trayaṃ bhavati pūjitam /
tato madhyagatāttasmādbodharāśeḥ sadaivatāt // 330
15.d:
मध्ये देव्यभिधा पूज्या त्रयं भवति पूजितम् ।
ततो मध्यगतात्तस्माद्बोधराशेः सदैवतात् ॥ 330
15.m: When the one called Goddess is worshipped in the center, the triad becomes worshipped. / Then, from that central mass of awareness, which is accompanied by the deities,

15.s:
aṅgādi niḥsṛtaṃ pūjyaṃ visphuliṅgātmakaṃ pṛthak /
madhyagā kila yā devī saiva sadbhāvarūpiṇī // 331
15.d:
अङ्गादि निःसृतं पूज्यं विस्फुलिङ्गात्मकं पृथक् ।
मध्यगा किल या देवी सैव सद्भावरूपिणी ॥ 331
15.m: the limbs and so forth, emerging like sparks, are to be worshipped separately. / Indeed, that Goddess who is in the center is the very embodiment of reality (sadbhāva);

15.s:
kālasaṃkarṣiṇī ghorā śāntā miśrā ca sarvataḥ /
siddhātantre ca saikārṇā parā devīti kīrtitā // 332
15.d:
कालसंकर्षिणी घोरा शान्ता मिश्रा च सर्वतः ।
सिद्धातन्त्रे च सैकार्णा परा देवीति कीर्तिता ॥ 332
15.m: she is Kālasaṃkarṣiṇī, terrible, peaceful, and mixed in every respect; / and in the Siddhātantra she is celebrated as the single-syllabled Parā Devī.

15.s:
parā tu mātṛkā devī mālinī madhyagoditā /
madhye nyasyetsūryaruciṃ sarvākṣaramayīṃ parām // 333
15.d:
परा तु मातृका देवी मालिनी मध्यगोदिता ।
मध्ये न्यस्येत्सूर्यरुचिं सर्वाक्षरमयीं पराम् ॥ 333
15.m: However, the Parā Mātṛkā Goddess Mālinī is declared to reside in the center; / in the center one should install Parā, possessing the splendor of the sun, consisting of all phonemes.

15.s:
tasyāḥ śikhāgre tvaikārṇāṃ tasyāścāṅgādikaṃ tviti /
tato viśvaṃ viniṣkrāntaṃ pūjitaṃ dakṣiṇottare // 334
15.d:
तस्याः शिखाग्रे त्वैकार्णां तस्याश्चाङ्गादिकं त्विति ।
ततो विश्वं विनिष्क्रान्तं पूजितं दक्षिणोत्तरे ॥ 334
15.m: On the tip of her crest [one should install] the single-syllabled [Goddess], and her limbs and so on. / Then the universe that has emerged is worshipped on the right and on the left;

15.s:
syādeva pūjitaṃ tena sakṛnmadhye prapūjayet /
śrīdevyāyāmale coktaṃ yāge ḍāmarasaṃjñite // 335
15.d:
स्यादेव पूजितं तेन सकृन्मध्ये प्रपूजयेत् ।
श्रीदेव्यायामले चोक्तं यागे डामरसंज्ञिते ॥ 335
15.m: it is certainly worshipped [thereby]; therefore one should worship her once in the center. / And in the venerable Devyāyāmala, in the sacrifice named Ḍāmara, it is taught:

15.s:
nāsāgre trividhaṃ kālaṃ kālasaṃkarṣiṇī sadā /
mukhasthā śvāsaniḥśvāsakalanī hṛdi karṣati // 336
15.d:
नासाग्रे त्रिविधं कालं कालसंकर्षिणी सदा ।
मुखस्था श्वासनिःश्वासकलनी हृदि कर्षति ॥ 336
15.m: “At the tip of the nose, Kālasaṃkarṣiṇī always draws within the heart / the threefold time, residing in the mouth, measuring out inhalation and exhalation.

15.s:
pūrakaiḥ kumbhakairdhatte grasate recakena tu /
kālaṃ saṃgrasate sarvaṃ recakenotthitā kṣaṇāt // 337
15.d:
पूरकैः कुम्भकैर्धत्ते ग्रसते रेचकेन तु ।
कालं संग्रसते सर्वं रेचकेनोत्थिता क्षणात् ॥ 337
15.m: With inhalations and retentions she holds it; with the exhalation, however, she devours it; / having arisen in an instant through the exhalation, she completely devours time.

15.s:
icchāśaktiḥ parā nāmnā śaktitritayabodhinī /
yājyā karṣati yatsarvaṃ kālādhāraprabhañjanam // 338
15.d:
इच्छाशक्तिः परा नाम्ना शक्तित्रितयबोधिनी ।
याज्या कर्षति यत्सर्वं कालाधारप्रभञ्जनम् ॥ 338
15.m: She is the supreme power of will by name, awakening the triad of powers; / she is to be worshipped because she draws in everything, destroying the support of time.”

15.s:
iha kila dṛkkarmecchāḥ śiva uktāstāstu vedyakhaṇḍanake /
sthūle sūkṣme kramaśaḥ sakalapralayākalau bhavataḥ // 339
15.d:
इह किल दृक्कर्मेच्छाः शिव उक्तास्तास्तु वेद्यखण्डनके ।
स्थूले सूक्ष्मे क्रमशः सकलप्रलयाकलौ भवतः ॥ 339
15.m: Here, indeed, perception, action, and will are spoken of as Śiva; when there is segmentation of the object of knowledge, / in the gross and subtle [realms], they become progressively the bound soul with cuirasṣes (sakala) and the knower dissolved in dissolution (pralayākala).

15.s:
śuddhā eva tu suptā jñānākalatāṃ gatāḥ prabuddhāstu /
pravibhinnakatipayātmakavedyavido mantra ucyante // 340
15.d:
शुद्धा एव तु सुप्ता ज्ञानाकलतां गताः प्रबुद्धास्तु ।
प्रविभिन्नकतिपयात्मकवेद्यविदो मन्त्र उच्यन्ते ॥ 340
15.m: Pure but asleep, they have attained the state of knowers free of instruments (jñānākala); but awakened, / knowing an object of knowledge consisting of a few differentiated entities, they are called Mantras.

15.s:
bhinne tvakhile vedye mantreśāstanmaheśāstu /
bhinnābhinne tadiyān suśivānto'dhvoditaḥ prete // 341
15.d:
भिन्ने त्वखिले वेद्ये मन्त्रेशास्तन्महेशास्तु ।
भिन्नाभिन्ने तदियान् सुशिवान्तोऽध्वोदितः प्रेते ॥ 341
15.m: When all objects of knowledge are differentiated, they are Lords of Mantras; their Great Lords (mantramaheśvara), however, / [abide] where [objects] are differentiated yet non-differentiated. This whole path ending in Good Śiva is proclaimed in the Corpse.

15.s:
tā eva galati bhedaprasare kramaśo vikāsamāyāntyaḥ /
anyonyāsaṃkīrṇāstvarātrayaṃ galitabhedikāstu tataḥ // 342
15.d:
ता एव गलति भेदप्रसरे क्रमशो विकासमायान्त्यः ।
अन्योन्यासंकीर्णास्त्वरात्रयं गलितभेदिकास्तु ततः ॥ 342
15.m: Those very [powers], as the expansion of differentiation dissolves, gradually expanding / and unmixed with one another, form the triad of spokes; and then, with differentiation dissolved,

15.s:
padmatrayyaunmanasī tadidaṃ syādāsanatvena /
tā evānyonyātmakabhedāvacchedanājihāsutayā // 343
15.d:
पद्मत्रय्यौन्मनसी तदिदं स्यादासनत्वेन ।
ता एवान्योन्यात्मकभेदावच्छेदनाजिहासुतया ॥ 343
15.m: the triad of lotuses is Unmanā. This constitutes the seat. / Through their desire to abandon the limitation of mutually differentiated forms,

15.s:
kila śaktitadvadādiprabhidā pūjyatvamāyātāḥ /
bhedagalanādyakoṭerārabhya yato nijaṃ nijaṃ rūpam // 344
15.d:
किल शक्तितद्वदादिप्रभिदा पूज्यत्वमायाताः ।
भेदगलनाद्यकोटेरारभ्य यतो निजं निजं रूपम् ॥ 344
15.m: these very [powers], with divisions such as power and possessor of power, have attained worshipfulness. / Because, beginning from the limit where differentiation dissolves, they maintain their respective forms,

15.s:
bibhrati tāstu tritvaṃ tāsāṃ sphuṭameva lakṣyeta /
saṃbhāvyavedyakāluṣyayogato'nyonyalabdhasaṃkarataḥ // 345
15.d:
बिभ्रति तास्तु त्रित्वं तासां स्फुटमेव लक्ष्येत ।
संभाव्यवेद्यकालुष्ययोगतोऽन्योन्यलब्धसंकरतः ॥ 345
15.m: their threefoldness is clearly observed. / Due to connection with the contamination of imaginable knowable objects and mutual mixing,

15.s:
prāk prasphuṭaṃ tribhāvaṃ nāgacchannatra tu tathā na /
anyonyātmakabhedāvacchedanakalanasaṃgrasiṣṇutayā /
svātantryamātrasārā saṃvitsā kālakarṣiṇī kathitā // 346
15.d:
प्राक् प्रस्फुटं त्रिभावं नागच्छन्नत्र तु तथा न ।
अन्योन्यात्मकभेदावच्छेदनकलनसंग्रसिष्णुतया ।
स्वातन्त्र्यमात्रसारा संवित्सा कालकर्षिणी कथिता ॥ 346
15.m: they did not previously appear clearly in a threefold nature, but here it is not so. / Because she devours the reckoning of the limitation of mutual differentiation, / that consciousness, whose essence is absolute autonomy alone, is called the Attractor of Time (Kālakarṣiṇī).

15.s:
saiva ca bhūyaḥ svasmātsaṃkarṣati kālamiha bahiṣkurute /
saṃkarṣiṇīti kathitā mātṛṣveteṣu sadbhāvaḥ // 347
15.d:
सैव च भूयः स्वस्मात्संकर्षति कालमिह बहिष्कुरुते ।
संकर्षिणीति कथिता मातृष्वेतेषु सद्भावः ॥ 347
15.m: She again draws forth time from herself and externalizes it here; / she is spoken of as Saṃkarṣiṇī, the reality (sadbhāva) among these mothers.

15.s:
tattvaṃ sattā prāptirmātṛṣu meyo'nayā saṃśca /
viśvajananīṣu śaktiṣu paramārtho hi svatantratāmātram // 348
15.d:
तत्त्वं सत्ता प्राप्तिर्मातृषु मेयोऽनया संश्च ।
विश्वजननीषु शक्तिषु परमार्थो हि स्वतन्त्रतामात्रम् ॥ 348
15.m: Reality, existence, attainment—among the mothers, the knowable exists through her; / for among the powers that generate the universe, the ultimate truth is absolute autonomy alone.

15.s:
eṣaṇavidikriyātmakametatpūjyaṃ yato'navacchinnam /
yasminsarvāvacchedadiśo'pi syuḥ samākṣiptāḥ // 349
15.d:
एषणविदिक्रियात्मकमेतत्पूज्यं यतोऽनवच्छिन्नम् ।
यस्मिन्सर्वावच्छेददिशोऽपि स्युः समाक्षिप्ताः ॥ 349
15.m: This [reality], consisting of desire, knowledge, and action, is to be worshipped because it is unconditioned, / in which even all directions of limitation are subsumed.

15.s:
avikalpamiha na yāti hi pūjyatvaṃ naca vikalpa ekatra /
bahavo dharmāstasmād yo dharmastāvato dharmān // 350
15.d:
अविकल्पमिह न याति हि पूज्यत्वं नच विकल्प एकत्र ।
बहवो धर्मास्तस्माद् यो धर्मस्तावतो धर्मान् ॥ 350
15.m: For here the non-conceptual does not attain worshipfulness, nor does a conceptual construct in a single entity; / there are many properties, and therefore whatever is a property [is unified in] that many properties.

15.s:
ākṣipati tatra rūḍhaḥ sarvotkṛṣṭo'dharasthitāstvanye /
iti bhairavaparapūjātattvaṃ śrīḍāmare mahāyāge // 351
15.d:
आक्षिपति तत्र रूढः सर्वोत्कृष्टोऽधरस्थितास्त्वन्ये ।
इति भैरवपरपूजातत्त्वं श्रीडामरे महायागे ॥ 351
15.m:
subsumes them; established therein, he is the highest of all, while the others remain below.
Thus the supreme essence of Bhairava's worship in the great sacrifice, in the venerable Ḍāmara,

15.s:
svayameva suprasannaḥ śrīmān śaṃbhurmamādikṣat /
bāhyayāge tu padmānāṃ tritaye'pi prapūjayet // 352
15.d:
स्वयमेव सुप्रसन्नः श्रीमान् शंभुर्ममादिक्षत् ।
बाह्ययागे तु पद्मानां त्रितयेऽपि प्रपूजयेत् ॥ 352
15.m:
was revealed to me directly by the venerable and most gracious Śambhu Himself.
In the external sacrifice, however, he should worship across all three lotuses

15.s:
astrāntaṃ parivāraughamiti no daiśikāgamaḥ /
agnīśarakṣovāyvantadikṣu vidyāṅgapañcakam // 353
15.d:
अस्त्रान्तं परिवारौघमिति नो दैशिकागमः ।
अग्नीशरक्षोवाय्वन्तदिक्षु विद्याङ्गपञ्चकम् ॥ 353
15.m:
the host of retinue [deities] ending with the weapon: such is the teaching of our teachers.
In the directions of fire, the Lord, the demon, and the wind, the group of five limbs of the Vidyā,

15.s:
śaktyaṅgāni śivāṅgāni tathaivātra punardvaye /
astraṃ nyasyeccaturdikkaṃ madhye locanasaṃjñakam // 354
15.d:
शक्त्यङ्गानि शिवाङ्गानि तथैवात्र पुनर्द्वये ।
अस्त्रं न्यस्येच्चतुर्दिक्कं मध्ये लोचनसंज्ञकम् ॥ 354
15.m:
as well as the limbs of Śakti and Śiva, are [installed] once more on these two [other lotuses].
He should deposit the weapon in the four directions, and in the center the [limb] called the Eye.

15.s:
patrāṣṭake'ṣṭakayugamaghorādeḥ svayāmalam /
tathā dvādaśakaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ catuṣkaṃ miśritaṃ dviśaḥ // 355
15.d:
पत्राष्टकेऽष्टकयुगमघोरादेः स्वयामलम् ।
तथा द्वादशकं षट्कं चतुष्कं मिश्रितं द्विशः ॥ 355
15.m:
On the eight petals, [he places] the pair of octads of Aghora and the rest with their respective dyads;
likewise, a group of twelve, six, and four, mixed by twos;

15.s:
sarvaśo dviguṇādītthamāvṛtitvena pūjayet /
lokapālāṃstataḥ sāstrānsvadikṣu daśasu kramāt // 356
15.d:
सर्वशो द्विगुणादीत्थमावृतित्वेन पूजयेत् ।
लोकपालांस्ततः सास्त्रान्स्वदिक्षु दशसु क्रमात् ॥ 356
15.m:
in all, doubled and so forth, he should worship them as circuits.
Then the guardians of the worlds along with their weapons in their ten directions in succession;

15.s:
itthaṃ triśūlaparyantadevītādātmyavṛttitaḥ /
tiṣṭhannatrārpayanviśvaṃ tarpayeddevatāgaṇam // 357
15.d:
इत्थं त्रिशूलपर्यन्तदेवीतादात्म्यवृत्तितः ।
तिष्ठन्नत्रार्पयन्विश्वं तर्पयेद्देवतागणम् ॥ 357
15.m:
standing thus with the state of oneness with the Goddess culminating in the trident,
offering the universe into this, he should satisfy the host of deities.

15.s:
tato japaṃ prakurvīta pratimantraṃ dvipañcadhā /
ekaikasya tryātmakatvādabhedāccāpi sarvaśaḥ // 358
15.d:
ततो जपं प्रकुर्वीत प्रतिमन्त्रं द्विपञ्चधा ।
एकैकस्य त्र्यात्मकत्वादभेदाच्चापि सर्वशः ॥ 358
15.m:
Then he should perform recitation ten times for each mantra,
since each is threefold and they are completely non-different in every respect.

15.s:
nābhihṛtkaṇṭhatālūrdhvakuṇḍe jvalanavatsmaran /
mantracakraṃ tatra viśvaṃ jvahvansaṃpādayeddhutim // 359
15.d:
नाभिहृत्कण्ठतालूर्ध्वकुण्डे ज्वलनवत्स्मरन् ।
मन्त्रचक्रं तत्र विश्वं ज्वह्वन्संपादयेद्धुतिम् ॥ 359
15.m:
Visualizing the circle of mantras like fire in the pit above the navel, heart, throat, and palate,
offering the universe into it, he should perform the oblation.

15.s:
dīkṣākarmaṇi kartavye dīkṣāṃ yenādhvanā guruḥ /
cikīrṣurdeha evādau bhūyastaṃ mukhyato'rpayet // 360
15.d:
दीक्षाकर्मणि कर्तव्ये दीक्षां येनाध्वना गुरुः ।
चिकीर्षुर्देह एवादौ भूयस्तं मुख्यतोऽर्पयेत् ॥ 360
15.m:
When the rite of initiation is to be performed, by whatever path the guru
desires to initiate, he should first and primarily project that into the [disciple's] body.

15.s:
dvādaśāntamidaṃ prāgraṃ triśūlaṃ mūlataḥ smaran /
devīcakrāgragaṃ tyaktakramaḥ khecaratāṃ vrajet // 361
15.d:
द्वादशान्तमिदं प्राग्रं त्रिशूलं मूलतः स्मरन् ।
देवीचक्राग्रगं त्यक्तक्रमः खेचरतां व्रजेत् ॥ 361
15.m:
Remembering this trident from the base up to its tip at the dvādaśānta,
standing at the forefront of the wheel of goddesses, free of succession, he attains the state of Khecara.

15.s:
mūlādhārāddviṣaṭkāntavyomāgrāpūraṇātmikā /
khecarīyaṃ khasaṃcārasthitibhyāṃ khāmṛtāśanāt // 362
15.d:
मूलाधाराद्द्विषट्कान्तव्योमाग्रापूरणात्मिका ।
खेचरीयं खसंचारस्थितिभ्यां खामृताशनात् ॥ 362
15.m:
This is Khecarī, having the nature of filling the sky's apex ending in the twelve-finger distance from the base,
because of moving and staying in the sky, and drinking the nectar of the sky.

15.s:
amuṣmācchāmbhavācchūlāddhrāsayeccaturaṅgulam /
śākte tato'pyāṇave tattriśūlatritayaṃ sthitam // 363
15.d:
अमुष्माच्छाम्भवाच्छूलाद्ध्रासयेच्चतुरङ्गुलम् ।
शाक्ते ततोऽप्याणवे तत्त्रिशूलत्रितयं स्थितम् ॥ 363
15.m:
From this Śāmbhava trident, he should diminish four finger-widths
for the Śākta [trident], and then also for the Āṇava: thus the triad of tridents is arranged.

15.s:
tattriśūlatrayordhvordhvadevīcakrārpitātmakaḥ /
kiṃ kiṃ na jāyate kiṃ vā na vetti na karoti vā // 364
15.d:
तत्त्रिशूलत्रयोर्ध्वोर्ध्वदेवीचक्रार्पितात्मकः ।
किं किं न जायते किं वा न वेत्ति न करोति वा ॥ 364
15.m:
Having surrendered himself to the wheel of goddesses above each of these three tridents,
what does he not become, what does he not know, or what does he not do?

15.s:
ekaikāmathavā devīṃ mantraṃ vā padmagaṃ yajet /
yāmalaikyāṅgavaktrādisadasattāvikalpataḥ // 365
15.d:
एकैकामथवा देवीं मन्त्रं वा पद्मगं यजेत् ।
यामलैक्याङ्गवक्त्रादिसदसत्ताविकल्पतः ॥ 365
15.m:
Or he may worship each single goddess or mantra situated on the lotus,
according to the conceptual options of reality and non-reality of the dyad, unity, limbs, and faces.

15.s:
itthaṃ prāṇādvyomapadaparyantaṃ cetanaṃ nijam /
śivībhāvyārcanāyogāttato bāhyaṃ vidhiṃ caret // 366
15.d:
इत्थं प्राणाद्व्योमपदपर्यन्तं चेतनं निजम् ।
शिवीभाव्यार्चनायोगात्ततो बाह्यं विधिं चरेत् ॥ 366
15.m:
Having thus made his own consciousness into Śiva from the breath
up to the abode of the sky through the application of worship, he should then perform the external rite.

15.s:
bahiryāgasya mukhyatve siddhyādiparikalpite /
antaryāgaḥ saṃskriyāyai hyanyathārcayitā paśuḥ // 367
15.d:
बहिर्यागस्य मुख्यत्वे सिद्ध्यादिपरिकल्पिते ।
अन्तर्यागः संस्क्रियायै ह्यन्यथार्चयिता पशुः ॥ 367
15.m:
When external sacrifice is considered primary for spiritual accomplishment and the like,
the internal sacrifice is for purification; otherwise the worshipper is a bound soul.

15.s:
yastu siddhyādivimukhaḥ sa bahiryajati prabhum /
antarmahāyāgarūḍhyai tayaivāsau kṛtārthakaḥ // 368
15.d:
यस्तु सिद्ध्यादिविमुखः स बहिर्यजति प्रभुम् ।
अन्तर्महायागरूढ्यै तयैवासौ कृतार्थकः ॥ 368
15.m:
He, however, who is averse to spiritual accomplishment and the like, worships the Lord externally
only for firmness in the great internal sacrifice; through that alone is his purpose achieved.

15.s:
kṛtvāntaryāgamādāya dhānyādyastreṇa mantritam /
dikṣu kṣipedvighnanude saṃhṛtyaiśīṃ diśaṃ nayet // 369
15.d:
कृत्वान्तर्यागमादाय धान्याद्यस्त्रेण मन्त्रितम् ।
दिक्षु क्षिपेद्विघ्ननुदे संहृत्यैशीं दिशं नयेत् ॥ 369
15.m:
Having performed the internal sacrifice, taking grains and the like empowered with the weapon,
he should cast them in the directions to dispel obstacles, and gathering them up, take them to the north-east.

15.s:
nirīkṣaṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ ca tāḍanāpyāyane tathā /
viguṇṭhanaṃ ca saṃskārāḥ sādhārāstriśiromate // 370
15.d:
निरीक्षणं प्रोक्षणं च ताडनाप्यायने तथा ।
विगुण्ठनं च संस्काराः साधारास्त्रिशिरोमते ॥ 370
15.m:
Gazing, sprinkling, striking, replenishing,
and veiling are the purifications with a support in the Triśirobhairava doctrine.

15.s:
gomūtragomayadadhikṣīrājyaṃ mantrayenmukhaiḥ /
ūrdhvāntairaṅgaṣaṭkena kuśāmbvetena cokṣayet // 371
15.d:
गोमूत्रगोमयदधिक्षीराज्यं मन्त्रयेन्मुखैः ।
ऊर्ध्वान्तैरङ्गषट्केन कुशाम्ब्वेतेन चोक्षयेत् ॥ 371
15.m:
He should empower cow dung, cow urine, curds, milk, and ghee with the faces
ending with the upward one, and kuśa water with the six limbs, and sprinkle [them] with this.

15.s:
bhūmiṃ śeṣaṃ ca śiṣyārthaṃ sthāpayetpañcagavyakam /
pañca gavyāni yatrāsminkuśāmbuni taducyate // 372
15.d:
भूमिं शेषं च शिष्यार्थं स्थापयेत्पञ्चगव्यकम् ।
पञ्च गव्यानि यत्रास्मिन्कुशाम्बुनि तदुच्यते ॥ 372
15.m:
He should set aside the ground, and the remainder of the five cow-products for the disciple.
Where the five cow-products are present in this kuśa water, that is called

15.s:
pañcagavyaṃ jalaṃ śāstre bāhyāśuddhivimardakam /
laukikyāmaviśuddhau hi mṛditāyāmathāntarīm // 373
15.d:
पञ्चगव्यं जलं शास्त्रे बाह्याशुद्धिविमर्दकम् ।
लौकिक्यामविशुद्धौ हि मृदितायामथान्तरीम् ॥ 373
15.m:
the water of five cow-products in the scripture, which crushes external impurity.
For once worldly impurity has been crushed, then in order to burn away

15.s:
aśuddhiṃ dagdhumāstheyaṃ mantrādi yadalaukikam /
phādināntāṃ smareddevīṃ pṛthivyādiśivāntagām // 374
15.d:
अशुद्धिं दग्धुमास्थेयं मन्त्रादि यदलौकिकम् ।
फादिनान्तां स्मरेद्देवीं पृथिव्यादिशिवान्तगाम् ॥ 374
15.m:
internal impurity, one must resort to mantras and the like, which are extra-worldly.
He should visualize the Goddess from the letter Pha to Na, extending from earth up to Śiva.

15.s:
puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipenmadhye dhūpagandhāsavādi ca /
tathaiva dadyādyāgaukomadhye tenāśu vigraham // 375
15.d:
पुष्पाञ्जलिं क्षिपेन्मध्ये धूपगन्धासवादि च ।
तथैव दद्याद्यागौकोमध्ये तेनाशु विग्रहम् ॥ 375
15.m:
He should toss a handful of flowers into the center, along with incense, perfume, liquor, and the like;
in the same way he should offer them within the sacrificial chamber, so that instantly

15.s:
samastaṃ devatācakramadhiṣṭhātṛ prakalpyate /
anantanāle dharmādipatre sadvaidyakarṇike // 376
15.d:
समस्तं देवताचक्रमधिष्ठातृ प्रकल्प्यते ।
अनन्तनाले धर्मादिपत्रे सद्वैद्यकर्णिके ॥ 376
15.m:
the entire circle of deities is conceived as the presiding presence.
On the stalk which is Ananta, on the petals which are dharma and the rest, on the pericarp which is the pure Vidyā,

15.s:
ṣaḍutthe gandhapuṣpādyairgaṇeśaṃ hyaiśagaṃ yajet /
atthitaṃ vighnasaṃśāntyai pūjayitvā visarjayet // 377
15.d:
षडुत्थे गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर्गणेशं ह्यैशगं यजेत् ।
अत्थितं विघ्नसंशान्त्यै पूजयित्वा विसर्जयेत् ॥ 377
15.m:
he should worship Gaṇeśa arising from the six [limbs] in the north-east with perfume, flowers, and the like.
Having worshiped him who has arisen to pacify obstacles, he should dismiss him.

[…] / […]

Then [he prepares] the pot filled with a fragrant liquid substance;

15.s:
pūjitaṃ carcitaṃ mūlamanunā mantrayecchatam /
asinā karkarīṃ pūrvamastrayāgo na cetkṛtaḥ // 379
15.d:
पूजितं चर्चितं मूलमनुना मन्त्रयेच्छतम् ।
असिना कर्करीं पूर्वमस्त्रयागो न चेत्कृतः ॥ 379
15.m:
worshiped and anointed, he should consecrate it a hundred times with the root mantra;
and the jug with the sword-[weapon], if the weapon-sacrifice was not performed earlier.

15.s:
tamaiśānyāṃ yajetkumbhaṃ vāmasthakalaśānvitam /
tataḥ sauradigāśrityā sāstrāṃllokeśvarānyajet // 380
15.d:
तमैशान्यां यजेत्कुम्भं वामस्थकलशान्वितम् ।
ततः सौरदिगाश्रित्या सास्त्रांल्लोकेश्वरान्यजेत् ॥ 380
15.m:
He should worship that pot in the north-east along with the water jug on the left.
Then, starting from the solar direction, he should worship the world-protectors along with their weapons

15.s:
gandhapuṣpopahārādyairvidhinā mantrapūrvakam /
tataḥ śiṣyo'sikalaśīhasto dhārāṃ prapātayan // 381
15.d:
गन्धपुष्पोपहाराद्यैर्विधिना मन्त्रपूर्वकम् ।
ततः शिष्योऽसिकलशीहस्तो धारां प्रपातयन् ॥ 381
15.m:
with perfume, flowers, offerings, and the like, according to the rule, preceded by mantras.
Then the disciple, holding the sword-jug in hand and pouring a stream [of water],

15.s:
guruṇā kumbhahastenānuvrajyo vadatā tvidam /
bho bhoḥ śakra tvayā svasyāṃ diśi vighnapraśāntaye // 382
15.d:
गुरुणा कुम्भहस्तेनानुव्रज्यो वदता त्विदम् ।
भो भोः शक्र त्वया स्वस्यां दिशि विघ्नप्रशान्तये ॥ 382
15.m:
is to be followed by the guru holding the pot in his hand, saying this:
"Ho, Śakra! By Śiva's command you must remain alert in your own direction

15.s:
sāvadhānena karmāntaṃ bhavitavyaṃ śivājñayā /
tryakṣare nirṛtiprāye nāmni bhoḥśabdamekakam // 383
15.d:
सावधानेन कर्मान्तं भवितव्यं शिवाज्ञया ।
त्र्यक्षरे निरृतिप्राये नाम्नि भोःशब्दमेककम् ॥ 383
15.m:
until the completion of the rite, for the pacification of obstacles!"
When the name has three syllables, such as Nirṛti, one should omit the single word "ho",

15.s:
apāsayedyato mantraśchandobaddho'yamīritaḥ /
tata aiśyāṃ diśi sthāpyaḥ sa kumbho vikiropari // 384
15.d:
अपासयेद्यतो मन्त्रश्छन्दोबद्धोऽयमीरितः ।
तत ऐश्यां दिशि स्थाप्यः स कुम्भो विकिरोपरि ॥ 384
15.m:
because this mantra is said to be metrically composed.
Then that pot should be placed upon the scattered [grains] in the north-eastern direction;

15.s:
dakṣiṇe cāstravārdhānī sthāpyā kumbhasya sāṃpratam /
kumbhasthāmbusamāpattivṛṃhitaṃ mantravṛndakam // 385
15.d:
दक्षिणे चास्त्रवार्धानी स्थाप्या कुम्भस्य सांप्रतम् ।
कुम्भस्थाम्बुसमापत्तिवृंहितं मन्त्रवृन्दकम् ॥ 385
15.m:
and on the right of the pot the weapon-vessel is now to be placed.
The host of mantras, expanded by the absorption of the water in the pot,

15.s:
tejomātrātmanā dhyātaṃ sarvamāpyāyayedvidhim /
ataḥ kumbhe mantragaṇaṃ sarvaṃ saṃpūjayedguruḥ // 386
15.d:
तेजोमात्रात्मना ध्यातं सर्वमाप्याययेद्विधिम् ।
अतः कुम्भे मन्त्रगणं सर्वं संपूजयेद्गुरुः ॥ 386
15.m:
visualized as consisting solely of light, invigorates the entire ritual.
Therefore, the guru should worship the entire group of mantras in the pot

15.s:
pūrveṇa vidhināstraṃ ca karkaryāṃ vighnanudyajet /
madhyegṛhaṃ tato gandhamaṇḍale pūjayedguruḥ // 387
15.d:
पूर्वेण विधिनास्त्रं च कर्कर्यां विघ्ननुद्यजेत् ।
मध्येगृहं ततो गन्धमण्डले पूजयेद्गुरुः ॥ 387
15.m:
according to the previous rule, and the weapon in the jug to dispel obstacles.
Then, in the center of the hall, upon a circle of fragrant paste, the guru should worship

15.s:
trikaṃ yāmalataikyābhyāmekaṃ vā mantradaivatam /
agnikāryavidhānāya tataḥ kuṇḍaṃ prakalpayet // 388
15.d:
त्रिकं यामलतैक्याभ्यामेकं वा मन्त्रदैवतम् ।
अग्निकार्यविधानाय ततः कुण्डं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 388
15.m:
the Trika through the dyad or oneness, or a single deity of the mantra.
Then, for the performance of the fire ritual, he should construct the fire pit,

15.s:
śuddhamantrādisaṃjalpasaṃkalpotthamapūrvakam /
śivasya yā kriyāśaktistatkuṇḍamiti bhāvanāt // 389
15.d:
शुद्धमन्त्रादिसंजल्पसंकल्पोत्थमपूर्वकम् ।
शिवस्य या क्रियाशक्तिस्तत्कुण्डमिति भावनात् ॥ 389
15.m:
which arises uncaused from the intention and recitation of pure mantras and the like,
from the contemplation: "The fire pit is the action-power of Śiva."

15.s:
paramaḥ khalu saṃskāro vināpyanyaiḥ kriyākramaiḥ /
evaṃ dehe sthaṇḍile vā liṅge pātre jale'nale // 390
15.d:
परमः खलु संस्कारो विनाप्यन्यैः क्रियाक्रमैः ।
एवं देहे स्थण्डिले वा लिङ्गे पात्रे जलेऽनले ॥ 390
15.m:
This indeed is the supreme purification, even without other ritual procedures.
Thus in the body, on the bare ground, in the liṅga, in a vessel, in water, in fire,

15.s:
puṣpādiṣu śiśau mukhyaḥ saṃskāraḥ śivatādṛśe /
uktaṃ śrīyogasaṃcāre tathāhi parameśinā // 391
15.d:
पुष्पादिषु शिशौ मुख्यः संस्कारः शिवतादृशे ।
उक्तं श्रीयोगसंचारे तथाहि परमेशिना ॥ 391
15.m:
in flowers and the like, in a disciple, the primary purification is such Śiva-nature.
For so it is declared by the Supreme Lord in the venerable Yogasaṃcāra:

15.s:
caturdaśavidhe bhūte puṣpe dhūpe nivedane /
dīpe jape tathā home sarvatraivātra caṇḍikā // 392
15.d:
चतुर्दशविधे भूते पुष्पे धूपे निवेदने ।
दीपे जपे तथा होमे सर्वत्रैवात्र चण्डिका ॥ 392
15.m:
"In the fourteen kinds of beings, in flowers, incense, food offerings,
in lights, recitation, and oblation, everywhere here Caṇḍikā alone

15.s:
juhoti japati preddhe pūjayedvihasedvrajet /
āhāre maithune saiva dehasthā karmakāriṇī // 393
15.d:
जुहोति जपति प्रेद्धे पूजयेद्विहसेद्व्रजेत् ।
आहारे मैथुने सैव देहस्था कर्मकारिणी ॥ 393
15.m:
offers oblations, recites, kindles fire, worships, laughs, and walks;
she alone, residing in the body, is the performer of action in eating and sexual union."

15.s:
tādṛśīṃ ye tu no rūḍhāṃ saṃvittimadhiśerate /
akramāttatprasiddhyarthaṃ kramiko vidhirucyate // 394
15.d:
तादृशीं ये तु नो रूढां संवित्तिमधिशेरते ।
अक्रमात्तत्प्रसिद्ध्यर्थं क्रमिको विधिरुच्यते ॥ 394
15.m:
For those, however, who do not abide in such established consciousness
without succession, a sequential procedure is taught for the attainment of that.

15.s:
ahaṃ śivo mantramayaḥ saṃkalpā me tadātmakāḥ /
tajjaṃ ca kuṇḍavahnyādi śivātmeti sphuṭaṃ smaret // 395
15.d:
अहं शिवो मन्त्रमयः संकल्पा मे तदात्मकाः ।
तज्जं च कुण्डवह्न्यादि शिवात्मेति स्फुटं स्मरेत् ॥ 395
15.m: "I am Śiva, consisting of mantra; my volitions have that as their nature; / and what is born from that—the fire-pit, fire, and so forth—is of the nature of Śiva": thus should one clearly remember.

15.s:
ata eva hi tatrāpi dārḍhyādārḍhyāvalokanāt /
kriyamāṇe kṛte vāpi saṃskriyālpetarāpivā // 396
15.d:
अत एव हि तत्रापि दार्ढ्यादार्ढ्यावलोकनात् ।
क्रियमाणे कृते वापि संस्क्रियाल्पेतरापिवा ॥ 396
15.m: For this very reason, there too, observing whether firmness or lack of firmness is present, / when it is being performed or after it has been performed, the consecration is either minimal or greater.

15.s:
yathāhi kaścitpratibhādaridro'bhyāsapāṭavāt /
vākyaṃ gṛhṇāti ko'pyādau tathātrāpyavabudhyatām // 397
15.d:
यथाहि कश्चित्प्रतिभादरिद्रोऽभ्यासपाटवात् ।
वाक्यं गृह्णाति कोऽप्यादौ तथात्राप्यवबुध्यताम् ॥ 397
15.m: Just as someone poor in intuitive flash, through proficiency in practice, / grasps a sentence [only after effort], while someone else [grasps it] at the outset, so should it be understood here as well.

15.s:
ullekhasekakuṭṭanalepacaturmārgamakṣavṛtiparikalanam /
staraparidhiviṣṭarasthitisaṃskārā daśāstrataḥ kuṇḍagatāḥ // 398
15.d:
उल्लेखसेककुट्टनलेपचतुर्मार्गमक्षवृतिपरिकलनम् ।
स्तरपरिधिविष्टरस्थितिसंस्कारा दशास्त्रतः कुण्डगताः ॥ 398
15.m: Drawing lines, sprinkling, pounding, smearing, the four paths, setting the barrier of stones, / spreading [grass], the enclosing sticks, placing the seat, and the [remaining] purifications: these ten belong to the fire-pit by means of the Astra [mantra].

15.s:
madhyagrahaṇaṃ darbhadvayena kuśasaṃvṛtiśca bhittīnām /
prāṅmukharekhātritayordhvarekhikāḥ kuśasamāvṛtiśca bahiḥ // 399
15.d:
मध्यग्रहणं दर्भद्वयेन कुशसंवृतिश्च भित्तीनाम् ।
प्राङ्मुखरेखात्रितयोर्ध्वरेखिकाः कुशसमावृतिश्च बहिः ॥ 399
15.m: Grasping the middle with two darbha blades, covering the walls with kuśa grass, / three eastward lines and upward lines, and covering with kuśa grass outside;

15.s:
śastalatāścaturaśraṃ daśalokeśārcanāsanavidhiśca /
sadmāsādanamastrāgnitejasā rakṣaṇaṃ ca kuṇḍasya // 400
15.d:
शस्तलताश्चतुरश्रं दशलोकेशार्चनासनविधिश्च ।
सद्मासादनमस्त्राग्नितेजसा रक्षणं च कुण्डस्य ॥ 400
15.m: The weapons, creeper patterns, the square, the rule of the seat for worshipping the ten world-protectors, / occupying the abode, and protecting the fire-pit with the radiant energy of the Astra fire;

15.s:
bhūmeḥ śivāgnidhṛtyai śaktirvighnāpasāraṇaṃ cārthāḥ /
tatastu pūjite kuṇḍe kriyāśaktitayā sphuṭam // 401
15.d:
भूमेः शिवाग्निधृत्यै शक्तिर्विघ्नापसारणं चार्थाः ।
ततस्तु पूजिते कुण्डे क्रियाशक्तितया स्फुटम् ॥ 401
15.m: Empowering the earth to support the fire of Śiva, and removing obstacles, are the purposes. / Then, when the fire-pit has been worshipped clearly as the power of action,

15.s:
mātṛkāṃ mālinīṃ vāpi nyasyetsaṃkalparūpiṇīm /
saṃkalpadevyā yatsṛṣṭidhāma tryaśraṃ kriyātmakam // 402
15.d:
मातृकां मालिनीं वापि न्यस्येत्संकल्परूपिणीम् ।
संकल्पदेव्या यत्सृष्टिधाम त्र्यश्रं क्रियात्मकम् ॥ 402
15.m: One should install the Mātṛkā or the Mālinī in the form of volition. / In that triangular abode of emission belonging to the goddess of volition, consisting of action,

15.s:
jñānaśukrakaṇaṃ tatra triḥ prakṣobhya vinikṣipet /
icchātaḥ kṣubhitaṃ jñānaṃ vimarśātmakriyāpade // 403
15.d:
ज्ञानशुक्रकणं तत्र त्रिः प्रक्षोभ्य विनिक्षिपेत् ।
इच्छातः क्षुभितं ज्ञानं विमर्शात्मक्रियापदे ॥ 403
15.m: One should deposit the semen-drop of knowledge after agitating it thrice. / Agitated by will, knowledge, established in the state of action whose nature is reflective awareness,

15.s:
rūḍhaṃ jñatvādipañcāṅgavispaṣṭaṃ jājvalītyalam /
tenāṅgapañcakaireva hutiṃ dadyātsakṛtsakṛt // 404
15.d:
रूढं ज्ञत्वादिपञ्चाङ्गविस्पष्टं जाज्वलीत्यलम् ।
तेनाङ्गपञ्चकैरेव हुतिं दद्यात्सकृत्सकृत् ॥ 404
15.m: Evident with the five limbs such as knowledge, blazes up intensely. / With those five limbs alone, therefore, one should offer an oblation once for each.

15.s:
janmādyakhilasaṃskāraśuddho'gnistāvatā bhavet /
pañcāṅgameva pṛthvyādirūpaṃ kaṭhinatādikāḥ // 405
15.d:
जन्माद्यखिलसंस्कारशुद्धोऽग्निस्तावता भवेत् ।
पञ्चाङ्गमेव पृथ्व्यादिरूपं कठिनतादिकाः ॥ 405
15.m: By this much, the fire becomes purified through all the consecrations beginning with birth. / Bearing the powers of solidity and so forth that reside in the fire, having the form of earth and the other [elements] as its five limbs,

15.s:
śaktīrdadhadvahnigatāḥ kuryādgarbhādikāḥ kriyāḥ /
tato'khilādhvasaddevīcakragarbhāṃ parāparām // 406
15.d:
शक्तीर्दधद्वह्निगताः कुर्याद्गर्भादिकाः क्रियाः ।
ततोऽखिलाध्वसद्देवीचक्रगर्भां परापराम् ॥ 406
15.m: One should perform the rites such as gestation. / Then, remembering the supreme-non-supreme [goddess], whose womb holds the circle of noble deities of the entire path,

15.s:
smaranpūrṇāhutivaśātpūrayedagnisaṃskriyāḥ /
tathā mantreśayuksatyasaṃkalpamahasā jvalan // 407
15.d:
स्मरन्पूर्णाहुतिवशात्पूरयेदग्निसंस्क्रियाः ।
तथा मन्त्रेशयुक्सत्यसंकल्पमहसा ज्वलन् ॥ 407
15.m: One should complete the consecrations of the fire through the full oblation. / Blazing thus with the brilliance of true volition conjoined with the lord of mantras,

15.s:
vahnistacchivasaṃkalpatādātmyācchivatātmakaḥ /
ityetatsaṃskriyātattvaṃ śrīśaṃbhurme nyarūpayat // 408
15.d:
वह्निस्तच्छिवसंकल्पतादात्म्याच्छिवतात्मकः ।
इत्येतत्संस्क्रियातत्त्वं श्रीशंभुर्मे न्यरूपयत् ॥ 408
15.m: The fire has the nature of Śiva-ness through identity with that volition of Śiva. / In this way, illustrious Śambhu explained to me the true reality of the consecration.

15.s:
mayāpi darśitaṃ śuddhabuddhayaḥ praviviñcatām /
tenātra ye codayanti yathā bālasya saṃskriyā // 409
15.d:
मयापि दर्शितं शुद्धबुद्धयः प्रविविञ्चताम् ।
तेनात्र ये चोदयन्ति यथा बालस्य संस्क्रिया ॥ 409
15.m: I too have shown it; let those of pure intellect examine it closely. / Therefore, as to those who object here: "Just as a child has consecration,

15.s:
bahnau vahnestathānyatretyanavasthaiva saṃskṛteḥ /
te nirutthānavihatā naye'smingurudarśane // 410
15.d:
बह्नौ वह्नेस्तथान्यत्रेत्यनवस्थैव संस्कृतेः ।
ते निरुत्थानविहता नयेऽस्मिन्गुरुदर्शने ॥ 410
15.m: In a fire, [and that] of a fire in another [fire], so there would be an infinite regress of consecration"— / they are silenced and refuted in this system, the doctrine of the guru.

15.s:
jāte'gnau saṃskṛte śaive śabdarāśiṃ ca mālinīm /
pitarau pūjayitvā svaṃ śuddhaṃ dhāma visarjayet // 411
15.d:
जातेऽग्नौ संस्कृते शैवे शब्दराशिं च मालिनीम् ।
पितरौ पूजयित्वा स्वं शुद्धं धाम विसर्जयेत् ॥ 411
15.m: When the Śaiva fire has been born and consecrated, having worshipped the aggregate of phonemes and Mālinī / as the two parents, one should dismiss them to their own pure abode.

15.s:
śuddhāgnerbhāgamādāya carvarthaṃ sthāpayetpṛthak /
athavāgneḥ śikhāṃ vāmaprāṇenādāya hṛjjuṣā // 412
15.d:
शुद्धाग्नेर्भागमादाय चर्वर्थं स्थापयेत्पृथक् ।
अथवाग्नेः शिखां वामप्राणेनादाय हृज्जुषा ॥ 412
15.m: Taking a portion of the pure fire, one should set it aside for the caru. / Or, taking a flame of the fire by means of the left breath dwelling in the heart,

15.s:
cidagninaikyamānīya kṣipeddakṣeṇa saṃskṛtām /
śiva ityabhimānena dṛḍhena hi vilokanam // 413
15.d:
चिदग्निनैक्यमानीय क्षिपेद्दक्षेण संस्कृताम् ।
शिव इत्यभिमानेन दृढेन हि विलोकनम् ॥ 413
15.m: Bringing it to unity with the fire of consciousness, one should cast it, consecrated, with the right [breath]. / For looking upon [everything] with the firm conviction: "This is Śiva,"

15.s:
sarvasya saṃskriyā tattvaṃ tattasmai yadyato'malam /
navāhutīratho dadyānnavātmasahitena tu // 414
15.d:
सर्वस्य संस्क्रिया तत्त्वं तत्तस्मै यद्यतोऽमलम् ।
नवाहुतीरथो दद्यान्नवात्मसहितेन तु ॥ 414
15.m: Is the true consecration of everything, since reality for him is pure because of that. / Then one should offer nine oblations with the Navātman [mantra],

15.s:
śivāgnaye tārapūrvaṃ svāhāntaṃ saṃskriyā bhavet /
śivacaitanyasāmānyavyoparūpe'nale tataḥ // 415
15.d:
शिवाग्नये तारपूर्वं स्वाहान्तं संस्क्रिया भवेत् ।
शिवचैतन्यसामान्यव्योपरूपेऽनले ततः ॥ 415
15.m: Preceded by Tāra and ending in svāhā, to the fire of Śiva; that constitutes the consecration. / Then, in the fire whose nature is the universal ether of the consciousness of Śiva,

15.s:
prāgvadādhāramādheyaṃ devīcakraṃ ca yojayet /
sruvaṃ srucaṃ ca saṃpaśyedadhovaktrau kramādguruḥ // 416
15.d:
प्राग्वदाधारमाधेयं देवीचक्रं च योजयेत् ।
स्रुवं स्रुचं च संपश्येदधोवक्त्रौ क्रमाद्गुरुः ॥ 416
15.m: The guru should unite the support, that which is supported, and the circle of goddesses as before. / He should look upon the ladles sruva and sruc turned downward in succession,

15.s:
śivaśaktitayābhyarcyau tathetthaṃ saṃskriyānayoḥ /
tattvasaṃdarśanānnānyatsaṃskārasyāsti jīvitam // 417
15.d:
शिवशक्तितयाभ्यर्च्यौ तथेत्थं संस्क्रियानयोः ।
तत्त्वसंदर्शनान्नान्यत्संस्कारस्यास्ति जीवितम् ॥ 417
15.m: To be worshipped as Śiva and Śakti. Thus is the consecration of the two; / for the life of a consecration is nothing other than the direct vision of reality.

15.s:
iti vaktuṃ sruvādīśaḥ śrīpūrve na samaskarot /
tatastilairmṛgīṃ madhyānāmāṅguṣṭhavaśādguruḥ // 418
15.d:
इति वक्तुं स्रुवादीशः श्रीपूर्वे न समस्करोत् ।
ततस्तिलैर्मृगीं मध्यानामाङ्गुष्ठवशाद्गुरुः ॥ 418
15.m: To declare this, the Lord did not consecrate the sruva and so forth in the illustrious Pūrva [śāstra]. / Then, forming the deer gesture with the middle, ring, and thumb fingers, the guru, with sesame seeds,

15.s:
kṛtvā mūlaṃ tarpayet śatenājyasruvaistathā /
aṅgavaktraṃ ṣaḍaṃśena śeṣāṃścāpi daśāṃśataḥ // 419
15.d:
कृत्वा मूलं तर्पयेत् शतेनाज्यस्रुवैस्तथा ।
अङ्गवक्त्रं षडंशेन शेषांश्चापि दशांशतः ॥ 419
15.m: Should gratify the root [mantra] with a hundred sruvas of clarified butter, / and in the same way, the limbs and the faces with a sixth part, and the remaining ones with a tenth part.

15.s:
sahasrādikahomo'pi tṛptyai vittānusārataḥ /
sati vitte'pi lobhādigrasto bāhyapradhānatām // 420
